title: Senior Full-Stack Developer / Founding Product Engineer
description:
The role at a glance

I'm hiring a senior full stack developer to turn a working TikTok Shop prototype into a secure, subscription SaaS product that sellers can sign up for and use on their own.





Focus

SaaS product development, ecommerce integrations, automation

Engagement

Independent contractor, contract to hire, or full time

Location

Remote, with working hours and communication cadence agreed together

Long term

Technical partner for additional business tools after this first product

About the opportunity

Our first product is a TikTok Shop management platform for sellers. It pulls shop operations, promotions, catalog management, profit reporting, orders, returns, affiliate outreach, content planning, and automation into one workspace.

This is not a website design job. I need someone who can own the technical path from prototype to a maintainable, commercially usable product, and who can explain decisions clearly to a nontechnical founder. Beyond this product, I want a long term partner who can help build more tools and reuse the right foundations across them.

Where the product stands today

We have a real codebase and a published demo, not a blank page concept.

What exists: Node.js, TypeScript, server rendered HTML, CSS and JavaScript, SQLite, and Docker. The app has account login, sample data dashboards, business logic tests, and code for several external integrations.

What is missing:

• The published version is demo only. Live merchant integrations have not been validated end to end.

• The local database is not suitable for durable, multi customer production use.

• Automated jobs are disabled in the demo.

• Customer onboarding, subscriptions, and multi tenant access still need to be built.

You will d
 what is worth keeping, what to refactor, and what to replace. I value a thoughtful migration plan far more than an automatic recommendation to rewrite everything.

What you will own

1. A customer ready SaaS product

• Self service signup: customers create a workspace, connect their own shop, invite teammates, choose a plan, and manage their account without developer help.

• Multi tenant architecture with strict separation of customer data, shop connections, background jobs, files, and permissions.

• Support for multiple shops per workspace where it makes sense, built to grow without a premature enterprise rebuild.

• Subscription billing, plan entitlements, usage limits, cancellation handling, and an internal support and admin interface kept separate from customer shop permissions.

2. Reliable TikTok Shop and third party integrations

• Full TikTok Shop integration: app configuration, OAuth, secure token storage, refresh and expiry handling, shop selection, reconnect flows, and deauthorization.

• Evaluate the developer app and distribution model needed to serve independent sellers, not just my own shop.

• Prepare technical materials for platform review, and clearly flag any business, legal, or compliance submissions I need to handle. Platform approval is never assumed.

• Validate API scopes, regional behavior, pagination, webhooks, rate limits, and API version changes. Treat TikTok Shop access and TikTok content publishing access as separate authorizations.

• Build further integrations in an agreed order, potentially Printify, Shopify, YouTube, Instagram, Pinterest, and
. Where a provider can't support something, say so plainly instead of faking it as a live feature.

3. Safe, trustworthy shop workflows

• Promotions and catalog: flash sale management and renewal, bulk product edits, previews, validation, progress tracking, and partial failure handling.

• Reporting: product level profit, costs, shipping, fees, refunds, settlements, ad spend, and exports, with estimates clearly separated from finalized numbers.

• Orders and returns: operational alerts, fulfillment integrations, return workflows, and configurable rules with customer approvals.

• Growth and content: goals, affiliate workflows, content planning, and authorized publishing or analytics where the APIs allow it.

Any action that changes prices, issues refunds, creates orders, or publishes content needs audit logs, preview or dry run modes, explicit permissions, and sensible limits. Retried jobs and repeated webhooks must never cause duplicate actions.

4. Production infrastructure and reliability

• Move persistent data out of the temporary container filesystem into a managed database and object storage.

• Separate development, staging, and production environments with isolated credentials and test data.

• Real queues and scheduled workers instead of relying on a web server staying awake, with job status, retries, idempotency, concurrency controls, alerts, and useful failure messages.

• Deployment pipelines, database migrations, monitoring, backups, restore procedures, and rollback.

• Automated checks for tenant isolation, permissions, critical business logic, and integration behavior.

5. Building with me and supporting future products

• Turn business ideas into clear technical requirements, prioritize the smallest useful release, and ship in reviewable increments.

• Explain tradeoffs in plain English, demo working features regularly, and raise blockers before they become surprises.

• Build reusable foundations (authentication, billing, integration adapters, background jobs) only where reuse is justified. No speculative frameworks.

• Keep the code readable, with architecture notes, setup instructions, operational docs, and a handoff another developer could follow.

• Keep repositories, cloud accounts, domains, and service access under company ownership.

What you bring

You have built and maintained a real SaaS product used by external customers, not only demos or marketing sites.

Required

• Full stack JavaScript and TypeScript, including Node.js backends and usable, responsive interfaces

• Relational databases: schema design, migrations, and multi tenant data isolation

• OAuth, server side secrets, token lifecycle management, and third party API integrations

• Background jobs, queues, webhooks, rate limiting, retries, and idempotent processing

• Subscription billing and authorization based on customer plans and roles

• Cloud deployment, Docker, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and production debugging

• Comfort inheriting existing code, reviewing AI assisted prototypes critically, and improving them without unnecessary rewrites

• Clear communication, real ownership, and sound product judgment

Strong advantage

• TikTok Shop or other marketplace seller APIs

• Shopify, Printify, or social publishing APIs

• Ecommerce financial reconciliation

• Subscription products and integration heavy automation platforms

I'm open to well reasoned changes in framework, database, or hosting. The goal is dependable delivery, not following a technology trend.

Initial milestones

These are outcome based. We'll agree on scope, sequencing, estimates, and budget after the first assessment.

1. Technical assessment and release plan. Review the codebase and integrations, identify security and reliability gaps, recommend a practical architecture, and define a narrow first paid release. List external approvals and dependencies separately from engineering work.

2. Production foundation. Durable storage, customer workspaces, access controls, separate environments, deployment checks, and operational visibility.

3. Live shop pilot. Connect a properly authorized pilot shop, validate an agreed set of real data workflows, and prove that one customer can't access another customer's records or credentials. External API approvals are a dependency, not a guaranteed date.

4. Paid beta. Self service onboarding, subscriptions, the prioritized workflows, support tooling, and documented recovery procedures. New features come only after the core product is reliable.

What success looks like

• Customers connect their own shops and use the product with no manual database edits or developer intervention.

• Customer data stays isolated.

• Reports clearly separate real, estimated, and unavailable data.

• Background jobs are observable and never duplicate business actions.

• Deployments and recovery are repeatable.

• I understand the roadmap, and another engineer could maintain the product.

How to apply

Please include:

1. Two or three relevant SaaS or integration projects, your specific role, and whether you maintained them after launch.

2. Your experience with marketplace APIs, OAuth, multi tenancy, billing, and background jobs.

3. A short explanation of how you would assess and productize an existing single shop Node/TypeScript prototype.

4. A production failure or integration problem you diagnosed and fixed.

5. Your availability, preferred engagement model, rate or compensation expectations, and timezone.

If your best work is private, a clear explanation or walkthrough is welcome. Just separate the work you personally owned from your team's.

title: Senior Real Estate Acquisitions Manager – Land Investing | GHL + AI
description:
Senior Real Estate Acquisitions Manager – Land Investing | GHL + AI

Schedule: U.S. Central Time business hours

Compensation: Up to $5,000 USD/month with the right experience

Experience: Minimum 5 years of U.S. real estate experience required



About Us

We are a U.S.-based real estate investment company specializing in land acquisitions, subdivisions, and development opportunities.



We are looking for an experienced Real Estate Acquisitions Manager who knows how to communicate with property owners, analyze deals, negotiate purchase prices, and move opportunities toward signed contracts.



This is NOT a cold-calling or entry-level virtual assistant position.



Your responsibility is to take over qualified seller leads, build relationships, evaluate opportunities, negotiate effectively, and turn conversations into profitable acquisitions.



We need someone who can think independently, communicate clearly, and take ownership of the entire acquisitions process.



Responsibilities

Seller Communication & Negotiation

Take over warm, qualified seller leads from our lead qualification team.

Build rapport and have natural, professional conversations with property owners.

Understand seller motivation, timeline, pricing expectations, and potential objections.

Negotiate purchase prices and contract terms.

Present offers within company-approved guidelines.

Follow up consistently with interested sellers.

Move qualified opportunities toward signed purchase agreements.

Maintain relationships with sellers throughout the acquisition process.

Property Research & Deal Analysis

Research comparable sales and determine realistic property values.

Analyze vacant land and potential development opportunities.

Research zoning, acreage, utilities, road access, flood zones, and property restrictions.

Identify potential deal breakers.

Understand acquisition costs, resale values, and profit margins.

Prepare clear deal summaries and recommendations.



CRM & Pipeline Management

Manage your acquisition pipeline in GoHighLevel (GHL).

Maintain accurate seller notes, follow-up tasks, and deal stages.

Track negotiations, offers, and contracts.

Coordinate with our lead qualification VA.

Provide concise daily updates on active opportunities.



AI & Technology

Use Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools to assist with research, analysis, communication, and productivity.

Understand effective prompting and how to verify AI-generated information.

Use Google Sheets, Land Portal, and other property research platforms.

Help identify ways to improve and streamline the acquisitions process.



Required Qualifications

5+ years of U.S. real estate experience, including at least 2 years in acquisitions or direct seller negotiation.

A track record of deals you personally negotiated through to a signed contract, and the ability to walk us through specific examples.

Experience pulling comparable sales and valuing property, including properties with limited comps such as vacant land.

Ability to run the numbers on a deal (acquisition cost, resale value, margin) and make a clear go/no-go recommendation.

Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, including pipelines, tasks, and notes.

Comfortable using Claude, ChatGPT, or similar AI tools for research and communication, and knows how to fact-check their output.

Excellent spoken and written English, with confidence on live calls with U.S. property owners.

Strong listening, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.

Independent problem-solving and decision-making ability.

Organized, persistent, and accountable.

Available to work U.S. Central Time business hours.



Preferred Experience

Vacant land acquisitions, including rural and infill parcels.

Real estate wholesaling or investment acquisitions.

Land Portal or similar land research tools.

Land development feasibility: zoning, utilities, access, flood zones, and subdivision potential.

Navigating county GIS, assessor, and recorder websites.

Preparing purchase agreements and coordinating with title companies through closing.

Creative deal structures such as seller financing or terms deals.



Who We’re Looking For

We want someone who is confident, personable, analytical, and results-driven.

You should enjoy speaking with sellers, asking intelligent questions, finding solutions, and negotiating deals.



We value people who:

Take initiative without being micromanaged.

Communicate clearly and concisely.

Listen carefully and follow directions.

Know how to build trust with property owners.

Can think through problems independently.

Follow up consistently.

Are comfortable using AI to work smarter.

Take ownership of results.

We are looking for someone interested in growing with our company long-term.



Compensation

Up to $5,000 USD/month with the right experience.



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY

We receive many applications. To be considered, you must complete ALL of the following steps.



Step 1 — Complete Our Application Form

Google Form: 



Step 2 — Submit Your Resume

Your resume must clearly show your U.S. real estate experience, including acquisitions, negotiations, and any deals you have personally helped secure.



Step 3 — Complete a DISC or Culture Index Assessment

 Submit your DISC or Culture Index results with your application.

 We are interested in understanding your natural communication, decision-making, and working style. There is no single correct personality profile.



Step 4 — Record a Short Video or Voice Introduction

 Submit a 2–3 minute Loom video or Vocaroo recording answering:

1. Tell us about your real estate acquisitions experience and a deal you personally helped negotiate.

2. How do you determine what to offer a seller for a property?

3. A seller wants $150,000, but your research indicates the property is worth $110,000. How would you handle that conversation?

4. How have you used GoHighLevel and Claude or other AI tools in your work?

We want to hear how you communicate and think, not a rehearsed script.



Step 5 — Attention to Detail

When submitting your application, include your favorite color in the subject line.



Applications missing the Google Form, resume, DISC/Culture Index results, recording, or subject-line instruction will not be considered.



We are looking for an experienced acquisitions professional, not someone who simply wants to learn real estate.



If you have the experience, communication skills, and motivation to help us acquire profitable properties, we look forward to hearing from you.

Outreach and business development — approximately 60%



- Research suitable brands, agencies, production companies and creative partners for paid collaborations, campaigns and projects.

- Identify relevant decision-makers and appropriate professional contact channels.

- Explain why each opportunity fits Paula, and propose a specific collaboration angle.

- Prepare personalized pitches, send approved outreach and manage agreed follow-ups.

Content and social media support — approximately 25%



- Edit short videos from supplied footage using CapCut or a comparable tool.

- Organize photos, videos and other assets so they are easy to find and reuse.

- Prepare captions, post drafts and a manageable publishing schedule.

- Suggest content that supports Paula's professional positioning and potential collaborations.



Research, planning and organization — approximately 15%



- Suggest new outreach angles and content ideas based on relevant research.

- Keep priorities and follow-ups organized.

- Provide a concise weekly update covering qualified leads, outreach, responses, promising opportunities, content delivered and next steps.

- Strong written English and a professional, natural communication style.

title: SDR Manager - Remote
description:
The Company



This search is being conducted on behalf of Accordant Capital, a Naperville-based family office and growth investment firm. Accordant was named to reflect the firm's commitment to alignment and partnership with entrepreneurs, emphasizing congruency between the goals of operators and the resources the firm provides. Accordant partners with growth-oriented entrepreneurs and CEOs who are seeking more than capital. The firm provides access to leadership talent, growth expertise, and a proven services playbook that enables founders to focus on what they do best — serving their markets in new and innovative ways. Because Accordant rarely raises outside capital, it can focus entirely on aligning its expertise and investment horizon with the needs of its operating companies.



Accordant has a long history of success in multiple industries. Its largest operating platform is MPHQ, serving the $30 billion healthcare compliance market, including market-leading brands MedPro Waste Disposal, HazPro Waste Disposal, and MP1 Solutions. MPHQ provides a growing suite of innovative services including regulated medical waste disposal, OSHA workplace safety, HIPAA certification, HR compliance training, pharmaceutical waste management, and secure document destruction to over 30,000 clients nationwide.



In addition to MPHQ, Accordant's diverse and growing operating company portfolio includes Mend Strategies, Modern Amenities, AIMS Group, and Break Through Closing — each reflecting the firm's approach of partnering with founders to scale businesses through strategic growth, operational excellence, and talent development.



Position Overview:



The SDR Manager will build MPHQ's outbound sales engine from the ground up — Accordant Capital's healthcare compliance platform — and own the revenue it produces. This manager will recruit and ramp a high-performing team, establish the sales motion, and create the operating discipline required to scale from an initial pilot pod to a 10+ rep organization. This is a net-new logo acquisition role — the focus is winning first-time customers, not expanding or renewing existing accounts."



The ideal candidate has done this before, can bring proven talent, and can demonstrate a track record of turning outbound teams into predictable revenue engines. You are a builder, not a caretaker — someone who has launched an outbound sales function from scratch, recruited high-performing sellers, and built the operating system that turns activity into predictable revenue.



Key Responsibilities:



Build the Program

●	Design and stand up the Company's outbound sales motion from zero — including ICP, targeting, messaging, cadences, qualification, objection handling, technology, QA, reporting, and operating rhythm.

●	Recommend the right team structure and pilot size, backed by data, and define the conditions for scaling to 10+ reps.

●	Build a repeatable full-cycle motion where reps prospect, qualify, handle objections, and close, with clear escalation for larger or more complex deals.

●	Partner with Technical/Data and Marketing on list quality, vertical targeting, lead generation, and sales enablement.

●	Design the SDR incentive and commission structure with HR and Finance and align it to qualified pipeline, closed-won revenue, and company economics.



Build the Team — Hire, Train, Retain

●	Own hiring for the team — define the rep profile, run the interview loop, and maintain a high bar for experienced sellers.

●	Recruit and ramp an initial 5-person pilot pod, then scale based on demonstrated production and unit economics.

●	Tap your own bench and network of proven SDRs, BDRs, inside sales reps, or closers who can accelerate time-to-productivity, subject to the Company's standard hiring process.

●	Build a repeatable onboarding and ramp program that shortens time-to-first-opportunity and time-to-quota.

●	Establish a rigorous coaching rhythm using live calls/recordings, with regular feedback on discovery, active listening, gatekeeper navigation, objection handling, and closing.

●	Own retention and performance management, keeping top producers engaged and accountable.



Own Revenue & Outbound Production

●	Track record of winning net-new, first-time customers (new logos) in a competitive or incumbent-vendor sales cycle — not primarily account expansion or renewal-based selling.

●	Experience closing larger, high-level, or enterprise/multi-stakeholder deals, in addition to high-volume outbound activity.

●	Own team targets for qualified opportunities, net-new customer acquisition, closed revenue, and quota attainment.

●	Build and execute outbound calling cadences into US provider offices — physician, dental, long-term care, veterinary, and other non-acute practices.

●	Ensure reps can position the Company's value on cost savings, compliance coverage, and service reliability, and handle price and incumbent-vendor objections.

●	Personally inspect the sales motion and intervene where activity, conversion, or close rates break down.

Pipeline, Process & Enablement

●	Create and maintain call guides, discovery frameworks, objection-handling guides, and playbooks.

●	Oversee call monitoring and QA to ensure consistent, professional, compliant customer interactions.

●	Use CRM, sales-engagement/sequencing, dialer, call-coaching, and reporting tools to drive transparency and accountability.

●	Monitor pipeline health, stage conversion, time-to-close, and bottlenecks; turn findings into specific process changes.

●	Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.



Performance, Reporting & Unit Economics

●	Track daily, weekly, and monthly KPIs — dials, connects, conversations, qualified opportunities, conversion, closed revenue, and quota attainment.

●	Own the sales funnel from activity through revenue and establish clear baseline conversion metrics.

●	Measure and improve unit economics, including cost per qualified opportunity, cost per acquisition, revenue per rep, and payback.

●	Use performance data to determine when to adjust the people, process, proposition, or investment level before scaling.

●	Provide concise, actionable reporting to US executive leadership and participate in strategic reviews.



Required Qualifications

●	5+ years in B2B outbound and consultative sales with a documented record of quota attainment, including hands-on prospecting and closing.

●	3+ years leading SDR, inside sales, or comparable outbound teams.

●	Required: demonstrated experience building and scaling an outbound sales function from zero — not simply managing an established team.

●	Documented track record with specific, quotable results from a team built and scaled to consistent quota attainment.

title: Senior Account Manager – Healthcare Compliance (B2B, Remote PH)
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company, serving 35,000+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

We're hiring a Senior Account Manager to own a portfolio of mid-market B2B healthcare clients — serving as their single point of accountability, growing the relationship, and protecting long-term retention. This isn't a transactional support role: you'll build executive-level trust, run business reviews, and drive measurable growth within your book of business.

1. Strategic Client Partnership



• Serve as the executive relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of strategic client accounts.

• Develop trusted partnerships with key decision-makers and executive stakeholders.

• Gain a deep understanding of each client's business objectives, operational challenges, and compliance priorities.

• Act as the client's strategic advisor by recommending solutions that improve business outcomes and strengthen the overall partnership.

• Develop and execute a Customer Council program and plan industry conferences, medical compliance forums, networking events, and educational sessions that build a strong MedPro and MP1 community, strengthen customer relationships, showcase the company's expertise and thought leadership, and position MedPro and MP1 as a trusted leader in the medical compliance industry.



2. Client Success & Experience



• Own the end-to-end client experience from implementation through renewal.

• Lead onboarding validation by ensuring services, billing, contacts, and operational expectations are accurately established.

• Monitor customer health and proactively address risks before they impact the client experience.

• Coordinate internal resources to ensure timely resolution of client issues and escalations.

• Drive customer satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy through proactive communication and continuous engagement.



3. Portfolio Growth & Value Creation



• Develop and execute strategic account plans for each assigned client.

• Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through additional services, compliance solutions, or operational improvements that create measurable client value.

• Lead renewal planning and contract discussions while protecting long-term client relationships.

• Maintain an active pipeline of expansion opportunities within the assigned portfolio.

• Achieve portfolio growth objectives while ensuring every recommendation aligns with the client's business needs and long-term success.



4. Portfolio Health Management



• Own the overall health and performance of an assigned client portfolio.

• Monitor client engagement, retention risks, service utilization, and satisfaction trends.

• Develop recovery strategies for at-risk accounts and coordinate cross-functional action plans.

• Maintain accurate account plans, forecasts, client documentation, and CRM records.

• Utilize portfolio insights and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement.



5. Cross-Functional Leadership



• Serve as the central point of coordination between clients and internal teams.

• Partner closely with Operations, Customer Support, Compliance, Finance, Product, and Sales to ensure a consistent client experience.

• Advocate for client needs while balancing operational capabilities and business objectives.

• Share customer insights to influence product enhancements, service improvements, and organizational priorities.

• Foster collaboration that enables MedPro and MP1 to consistently exceed client expectations.



Required Qualifications:



• 3–5 years of experience in Strategic Account Management, Customer Success, Client Success, Business Development, or • Account Management. 

• Proven experience managing a portfolio of B2B clients while driving client satisfaction, retention, and account growth. 

• Demonstrated success conducting business reviews, renewal discussions, and identifying expansion opportunities. 

• Strong consultative communication and relationship-building skills with multiple stakeholder levels. 

• Experience collaborating across Operations, Customer Support, Finance, Product, and Sales to deliver client outcomes. 

• Proficient in CRM systems, account planning, and customer performance analysis. 

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred.

• Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will be considered.



Typical Portfolio:

• Full accountability for renewals, client health, strategic account planning, and portfolio growth within this book of business

title: Experienced B2B SDR / Cold Caller — U.S. Real Estate Development & Financial Services (Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
Experienced B2B SDR / Cold Caller — U.S. and Canada Real Estate Development & Financial Services (Part-Time, Long-Term)





**Starting Schedule:** 10–12 hours per week  

**Hours:** U.S. business hours  

**Start:** Immediately  

**Initial Engagement:** 14-Day Paid Trial  



About the Opportunity



We are a U.S.-based B2B financial technology and services business seeking an experienced, self-directed Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help establish and grow our outbound sales pipeline.



Our target market consists of real estate development companies, commercial property developers, and established real estate investment and development firms throughout the United States.



We provide specialized financial planning and management solutions designed for businesses managing complex real estate development projects.



We need someone who can independently identify qualified companies, reach business owners and senior decision-makers, conduct professional outbound conversations, and schedule qualified sales demonstrations.



This is not a real estate agent, residential wholesaling, property acquisition, or general virtual assistant position.



We are looking for someone who understands professional B2B prospecting and can confidently engage business executives.



Your Responsibilities



- Independently research U.S. real estate development companies and identify qualified prospects.

- Identify owners, managing partners, development principals, CFOs, finance directors, and other relevant decision-makers.

- Find and verify business contact information using reliable research methods.

- Conduct outbound cold calls during U.S. business hours.

- Send personalized prospecting
s and manage follow-up communication.

- Initiate professional conversations about financial planning, project management challenges, and operational needs.

- Qualify prospects based on business relevance, decision-making authority, current needs, and interest.

- Schedule confirmed sales demonstrations directly onto our calendar.

- Maintain accurate CRM records, contact notes, call outcomes, and follow-up tasks.

- Provide concise daily activity reports and pipeline updates.

- Work independently with minimal supervision.



You are not responsible for conducting product demonstrations, providing financial advice, negotiating contracts, or closing sales. Our U.S.-based team handles those responsibilities.



Who You Will Be Contacting



Our ideal prospects include:



- Owners and principals of established real estate development companies

- Managing partners of development firms

- CFOs and financial executives

- Directors of real estate development

- Executives responsible for multiple development projects and financial planning



We are primarily interested in companies actively developing commercial, multifamily, mixed-use, or other substantial real estate projects.



We are NOT targeting individual residential real estate agents, mortgage brokers, residential wholesalers, or consumers.



Required Qualifications



- Minimum 2 years of proven U.S. B2B outbound cold-calling or appointment-setting experience.

- Excellent spoken English and professional telephone communication.

- Proven experience speaking directly with business owners, executives, or senior decision-makers.

- Ability to independently research and build targeted prospect lists.

- Experience using CRM systems and outbound calling software.

- Strong objection-handling and discovery-question skills.

- Ability to maintain accurate prospect records and organized follow-up processes.

- Comfortable working U.S. business hours.

- Able to work independently without constant direction.



Preferred Experience



We are particularly interested in candidates with experience prospecting or selling to:



- Commercial real estate development companies

- Construction and development businesses

- Real estate investment or asset management firms

- Financial software or B2B SaaS buyers

- CFOs, finance directors, and business owners

- Professional services organizations



Industry-specific experience is an advantage, but demonstrated success in executive-level B2B cold calling is more important.



Compensation and Growth



We are starting with a paid 14-day trial at approximately 10–12 hours per week.



Successful candidates will have the opportunity to increase their hours and develop into a long-term position as the outbound sales operation grows.



We value independent execution, quality conversations, reliable follow-through, and measurable sales results.



How to Apply



Please answer all five questions: 



1. How many years have you personally spent cold calling U.S. B2B decision-makers? Have you worked with real estate developers, construction companies, financial services firms, or SaaS businesses?



2. During your most recent B2B outbound campaign, how many qualified appointments did you book, and how many actually attended? Over what period were those results achieved?



3. If we provided no lead list, how would you independently identify and verify U.S. real estate development companies and their owners, CFOs, or managing partners?



4. Which tools have you personally used for cold calling, prospect research, and CRM management? Have you independently managed an outbound sales pipeline from research through appointment booking?



5. Suppose you needed to find 100 established U.S. real estate developers managing multiple projects. Explain exactly where you would search, how you would identify financial decision-makers, and how you would prioritize the strongest prospects.



Required Voice Recording:



Please include a 60–90-second English voice recording introducing yourself, describing your U.S. B2B sales experience, and demonstrating how you would professionally open a cold call with a real estate development company owner.



Begin your application with: DEVCFO2026



Applications without complete screening answers or a voice recording will be bypassed.



We are looking for a proven, independent B2B appointment setter who can generate high-quality sales opportunities—not someone who requires extensive cold-calling training.



We are ready to move quickly with the right candidate.

title: Operations & Project Execution (Fast Growing)
description:
Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company

Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers.



This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal.



What You Get If You Win Here

- High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos

- Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company.

- Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics.

- Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before.

- Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves!

If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up:

Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace.

Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs.



We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who:

Can’t drive tasks to completion independently

Mark tasks complete with no proof

Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing.

Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru

Need hand-holding

I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners.



What You’ll Actually Do

You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs:

Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed

Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin)

Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items

Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked

We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply.



How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days)

We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want.



Real Growth Example

One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly.



Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises)

This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment.



What Winning Looks Like

By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership.



If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.”



Who This Is NOT For

You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence.

You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level.

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure

You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side.

You are mass applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first.





Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs.

You hate corporate BS– endless meetings, vague goals, and politics – and would rather be rewarded for what you actually create.

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.



Comp & Growth

(All of this is written into your contract.)

Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial

• $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit.

• No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors.

Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside

• Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward.

• On top of base, you can earn:

$400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them).

$1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard.

• In practice, that means:

Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month

Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month

All bonuses are 100% KPI based (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture.



Training & Growth Investment (on top of pay)

We actively invest in making you a sharper teammate. Over time, we’ll put thousands of dollars into your development (courses, coaching, playbooks, and tools) that we choose together based on what will make you more effective in this seat.

We also protect uninterrupted deep work blocks for you every week (no random meetings, no Slack spam). You’re paid to ship outcomes, not sit in back to back Zoom calls.



Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to.

95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit.



Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.



How To Apply (24-Hour Test)

Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises)



If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are:

A short interview focused on your past execution.

A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit.



Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must:



Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine):

Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove from messy start to completion where you did most of the execution yourself, not just assigning tasks. Include at least one example of how you set your own deadlines and moved forward when other people were slow to respond.”

Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each.

Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders.

Q4: Below are 6 messy “tasks” we actually see (all dumped into one list):

– “Fix Asana, it’s a mess”

– “Seller lead texting follow up??”

– “Finance com/projections cadence d2 ”

– “Inventory backlog insane”

– “Need better reporting”

– “Update SOPs

In this role you will NOT have anyone to delegate to assume it’s just you and the Ops Manager.

In a Google Doc, please:



Rewrite these into clear tasks with: Owner (you or Ops Manager), Due Date (next 7–30 days), and a concrete Done Check + proof required. “Write your task descriptions as if you are committing: ‘I will do X by Y time. If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.”

Put them in the order you’d actually do them and explain why in 3–5 bullet points.



Link the Google Doc here (view access).



Spend no more than 30–45 minutes. If you can’t figure this out on your own, this role will be too hard in real life – that’s okay, just skip applying.



Attach your PDF resume/Google Drive link.

title: Scheduler - Dental
description:
Company: Smile Group

Position: Dental Scheduler

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time EST time

Compensation: $2.50 USD/hour base pay + $2.00 USD per qualifying appointment scheduled



About the Position



Smile Group is looking for a motivated, confident, and knowledgeable Dental Scheduler to join our team remotely.



This is not a traditional call-center position.



Our schedulers are an important part of each dental office and are often the first point of contact for our patients. You will work directly with our dental teams to answer incoming calls, make outbound calls, schedule patients, answer common dental questions, and help keep our doctors’ and hygienists’ schedules full.



We are specifically looking for candidates who already have dental knowledge and dental scheduling experience or a strong understanding of dental procedures, terminology, and appointment types.



Fluent English and Spanish is required for this position.



Compensation



The compensation structure is designed to reward performance:



Base Pay: $2.50 USD per hour

Performance Bonus: $2.00 USD per qualifying appointment you successfully schedule



This means your earning potential is directly connected to your performance. The more successful appointments you create, the more you can earn.



For performance bonuses, appointments must meet the company’s qualification requirements, including patient attendance/completion when applicable.



We want motivated schedulers who are excited by the opportunity to earn additional compensation by helping keep our offices productive and our schedules full.



Main Responsibilities



Your primary responsibility will be to answer incoming patient calls and make outbound calls to schedule patients.



You will work with multiple scheduling opportunities, including:



New patient calls and inquiries

New patient scheduling

Patient reactivation

Patients who missed previous appointments

Patients who canceled and need to reschedule

Patients due for hygiene/cleaning appointments

Patients who completed SRP and are due for periodontal maintenance

Patients with treatment plans who have not scheduled

Patients who have already paid for treatment but do not have an appointment

Following up with patients to help fill openings in the schedule

Confirming and maintaining productive schedules

Helping the offices work toward zero missed calls

Dental Knowledge Is Required



This position requires more than excellent phone skills.

You must be able to speak confidently with patients about common dental procedures and appointments.



For example, you should understand or be able to confidently explain:



The difference between a regular prophylaxis/prophy and Scaling and Root Planing (SRP)

Why a patient may need SRP instead of a regular cleaning

What a patient can expect during common dental appointments

How many appointments may be required for a crown

Basic steps involved in crown treatment

Basic implant treatment processes

Pre-operative and post-operative appointments related to implants

Hygiene and periodontal maintenance appointments

Common dental terminology

How to schedule different dental procedures appropriately



We do not expect the scheduler to diagnose patients or answer questions that require a dentist or clinical provider. However, you should be able to confidently handle common patient questions without unnecessarily transferring every call.



Our goal is minimum unnecessary escalations and minimum unnecessary transfers to office managers.



Language Requirements

Fluent English and Spanish is required.

Because you will be speaking with patients throughout the day, you must be able to communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently in English and Spanish, both verbally and in writing.



You should be comfortable:



Answering patient calls in English

Explaining dental appointments and procedures clearly

Handling patient questions confidently

Communicating professionally through phone calls, text messages, and other patient communication channels

Understanding patients with different speaking styles and accents

Providing a high level of customer service in English



Bilingual English/Spanish candidates are encouraged to apply.



You Are Part of the Dental Office



We do not want our patients to feel like they are speaking with an outside call center.



You should never approach a patient conversation with:



“This is the call center. Let me transfer you to the office.”



You are part of the office team.



We want our patients to feel that they are speaking directly with a knowledgeable member of their dental office who understands their needs and can help them.



The scheduler is one of the most important roles in our organization because you:



Create the appointments that fill the doctors’ schedules

Help patients receive the treatment they need

Create the patient's first impression of our practice

Help prevent missed opportunities

Support the doctors, hygienists, managers, and clinical teams

Help maintain healthy and productive schedules



What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate will have:



Fluent spoken and written English — required

— a plus

Previous dental scheduling, dental receptionist, dental call center, or dental patient coordinator experience

Good knowledge of dental terminology

Understanding of common dental procedures

Experience scheduling dental appointments

Strong customer service skills

Confidence speaking with patients

Excellent telephone etiquette

Ability to explain information clearly and professionally

Strong follow-up skills

Ability to handle objections and encourage patients to schedule

High motivation and a performance-driven mindset

Ability to work independently

Reliability and consistency

Strong attention to detail

Ability to learn our systems and protocols quickly

A positive, team-oriented attitude

Performance Expectations



Success in this position will be measured by your ability to:



Answer calls consistently

Help us achieve as close to zero missed calls as possible

Create quality appointments

Convert patient inquiries into scheduled appointments

Follow up consistently with unscheduled patients

Keep schedules full

Communicate professionally with patients

Reduce unnecessary transfers

Understand dental appointment types

Work as a true member of the dental office team



This is a great opportunity for someone who already understands dentistry and enjoys speaking with patients, scheduling treatment, and working toward performance goals.



Shift: Mondays - Fridays 11:00PM - 6:30AM EST

Saturdays - 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST



Please include:

Your resume

Your previous dental experience

The dental software you have used

Your experience scheduling dental procedures

A short explanation of the difference between a prophy and an SRP

Your experience handling incoming and outbound patient calls

Your English and  Spanish proficiency level

Your available working hours

Your internet speed and computer specifications



Important: Strong dental knowledge and fluent English are important requirements for this position. Applicants without sufficient dental knowledge may not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a real part of the Smile Group dental team, provide an excellent patient experience, and take advantage of a performance-based compensation structure with the opportunity to increase their earnings through successful scheduling.

+ minutes)

title: AI VIDEO MAKER/EDITOR | FACEBOOK ADS (E-COMMERCE)
description:
We're looking for an AI video maker/editor who understands one thing clearly:

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We need someone who can help us produce high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels. This is a full-time position (40 hours per week).



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

- AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

- Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits showing the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about beautiful visuals. We want someone who understands how ads actually work.

You should know how to make videos that:

- Stop people in the first 1-3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

- Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:

- HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

- ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

- Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

- At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use



Ideally, you also have experience with:

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

- Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

- Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

- Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

- Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



WHAT YOU GET

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.

If you're an AI video maker/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Guest Support VA
description:

Key Responsibilities:



Guest Communication & Support

- Respond promptly and professionally to guest inquiries via phone,
, chat, and messaging platforms.

- Assist guests with reservations, booking modifications, check-in/check-out instructions, and property information.

- Resolve guest concerns efficiently while maintaining excellent customer service.

- Follow up with guests and assist in managing guest reviews and feedback.



Booking Management

- Manage reservations across multiple booking platforms, including Airbnb, 
, VRBO, and Hostaway.

- Update booking calendars and reservation details.

- Coordinate with housekeeping and maintenance teams to ensure properties are guest-ready.

- Block dates, adjust reservations, and communicate schedule changes when necessary.



Property Management Support

- Maintain and update property listings with accurate descriptions, amenities, pricing, and photos.

- Conduct regular listing audits to ensure information is current and optimized.

- Coordinate routine and emergency maintenance with vendors and internal teams.



Content & Listing Optimization

- Create and update engaging content for our company
 page

- Improve listing descriptions, titles, amenities, and house manuals to increase bookings and enhance the guest experience.



Administrative Support

- Perform various administrative tasks as assigned.

- Assist in creating and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

- Maintain organized records and documentation.

- Support operations and special projects when needed.



Qualifications

- Experience in short-term rental (STR), Airbnb, vacation rental, or property management is required.

- Strong customer service background with a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Extremely detail-oriented and organized. 

- Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making skills.

- Able to prioritize urgent tasks and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.

- Proactive, resourceful, and takes initiative.

- Quick learner who can adapt to new software and processes. 

- Available to work during U.S. business hours, including overnight/night shifts. 



Compensation: $4 per hour starting rate and increase after probation period to $5/hr. 



How to Apply



To be considered for this position, please complete the Google Form below: 



Required Application Materials



We are looking for applicants who take the time to submit a thoughtful application. Please do not submit a generic or copy-and-paste application.We want to get to know you and understand why you're a good fit for this role.



Please include all of the following:

1. Updated Resume

2. Loom Video (3–5 minutes)

title: Operations Manager - Real Estate Wholesaling
description:
OPERATIONS MANAGER - REAL ESTATE WHOLESALING



Erie Property Solutions | Full-Time | Remote

40 hrs/week, US Eastern Time business hours

Hourly pay + performance-based bonuses





ABOUT US



Erie Property Solutions wholesales residential properties throughout Ohio and helps homeowners find solutions for their properties. We're building a scalable, results-driven business and need an experienced Operations Manager to run daily operations, lead our remote team, and drive consistent execution.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. OPERATIONS & TEAM MANAGEMENT

- Run day-to-day operations and manage/audit outreach specialists, acquisitions, and other team members.

- Hold regular check-ins and accountability meetings; follow up on outstanding tasks.

- Solve operational issues and escalate key decisions to ownership.

- Manage and audit team payroll.



2. LEAD PIPELINE & CRM

- Ensure every lead is documented, categorized, assigned, and followed up on schedule.

- Track leads from first contact through qualification, acquisition, and disposition.

- Catch leads falling through the cracks and fix the breakdown.

- Keep CRM records accurate and oversee nurturing, drip campaigns, and follow-up sequences.



3. KPIs & PERFORMANCE

- Maintain dashboards tracking lead volume, contact rates, follow-ups, appointments, contracts, and closings.

- Spot trends, bottlenecks, and performance gaps early and adjust.

- Deliver concise weekly reports to ownership with specific recommendations to improve conversion, productivity, and profit.

- Connect activity metrics to business outcomes, not just report numbers.



4. COACHING & TRAINING

- Train the team on processes, expectations, and SOPs.

- Coach outreach and acquisitions on seller communication, rapport, objection handling, and follow-up using NEPQ.

- Review calls, texts, and data to find areas for improvement; build improvement plans and track results.

- Document performance issues and identify when team changes are needed.



5. SYSTEMS & IMPROVEMENT

- Create and maintain SOPs and make sure the team follows them.

- Streamline or automate repetitive tasks; work with CRM/tech support to fix system issues.

- Increase the number of qualified opportunities reaching acquisitions.





IDEAL CANDIDATE



- 3+ years in real estate wholesaling or investment operations with US sellers.

- Experience managing remote outreach, acquisitions, or sales teams.

- Experience with CRMs, pipeline management, SOPs, dashboards, and accountability systems.

- Strong with KPIs and data-driven decisions.

- Familiar with NEPQ or similar consultative sales approaches and seller psychology.

- Excellent written and spoken English; understands US culture.

- Highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable working US EST hours.





THIS IS NOT A TASK-DOER ROLE



You are the people leader, performance driver, and daily operator of our business. This isn't a background seat where the team runs itself and you send a weekly report. We need someone who takes ownership, spots problems early, holds themselves and others accountable, and builds a transparent, organized team culture. If you love moving pipelines and turning leads into revenue, this is your seat.





HOW TO APPLY



Submit your resume plus voice recordings (
 or similar - post the links) answering:



1. COLD CALLING: In 1-2 minutes, how would you handle a hesitant, guarded seller? How do you build rapport and guide the conversation?



2. COACHING: How would you coach a team member struggling to convert leads?



3. ENGLISH: Tell us about your background and why you want this role. Mention any English certifications (C1 or similar).



4. KPIs: How do you balance front-end coaching with back-end data analysis? How do the numbers tell you someone needs help, and what do you do about it?



5. Anything else you'd like us to know.

title: Remote Bookkeeper - Freight Brokerage (QuickBooks)
description:

- Hands-on QuickBooks experience (Online preferred) is non-negotiable. If you have not done day-to-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks, do not apply.

- Solid AR, AP and bank reconciliation experience

- Strong attention to detail and comfort with spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel)

- Excellent written English

- Available during US Eastern Time business hours

- Reliable internet connection and a professional home office setup

- You don't wait to be told something is off -- you catch it and speak up



How to Apply



Submit your application at







Along with your resume, you must include a short personality video -- 2 to 3 minutes -- telling us:



1. Your name and where you're located in the Philippines

2. Your specific bookkeeping experience, and which accounting software you've used

title: Video Editor
description:

The brand has grown almost entirely on organic short-form content, and video is the engine of the business. What you'll do

- Cut paid ad creatives for Meta 
/Instagram), including multiple hook and length versions of the same ad for testing

Nice to have

Working with us

title: Full-Time Maintenance & Repair Manager — NYC Apartment Buildings (Remote, Philippines Only)
description:
We are a US-based real estate company managing apartment houses across the boroughs of New York City. We are hiring a full-time, long-term Maintenance & Repair Manager to run day-to-day maintenance and repairs across our NYC portfolio, working remotely from the Philippines.



Location: Remote — Philippines only. Work from home in the Philippines.

Category: Maintenance / Property Management



What you'll do:

- Receive and triage tenant maintenance requests / work orders; prioritize by urgency

- Dispatch and coordinate vendors and contractors (plumbers, electricians, HVAC techs, handymen) — get quotes, compare, schedule, follow up

- Handle emergency calls after hours — assess the situation, dispatch help, follow through until resolved

- Schedule and track preventive maintenance (boilers, HVAC, elevators, common areas, seasonal items)

- Coordinate inspections; follow up on violations and corrections

- Track every job from request to completion; keep owners/managers updated

- Maintain vendor lists, service records, and maintenance logs



What we're looking for:

- 5+ years coordinating maintenance/repairs for residential apartment buildings (US properties strongly preferred)

- Working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and general building systems — enough to diagnose issues, scope work, and talk shop with contractors

- Familiarity with NYC building codes and common violations a big plus

- Experience managing vendors: sourcing, quotes, scheduling, quality follow-up

- Excellent written and spoken English; calm under pressure on emergency calls

- Reliable high-speed internet + backup

- Able to work full-time New York hours and be on call for after-hours emergencies

- AppFolio (maintenance module) or similar property-management software a big plus



What we offer:

- Full-time, long-term remote role

- Salary up to ₱80,000/month, based on experience

- 13th-month pay

- Paid time off



To apply, answer these in your application (applications without answers will not be considered):

1. How many years have you coordinated maintenance/repairs for residential apartment buildings? Describe the portfolio (how many units/buildings, where).

2. Walk through an emergency repair you handled end-to-end — e.g. a burst pipe or heat outage. What did you do first, who did you call, how did you follow through?

3. How do you manage vendors/contractors — sourcing, quotes, scheduling, and making sure the job actually gets done right?

4. What property-management or maintenance software have you used (AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi, etc.)? What did you do in it?

5. What is your internet speed + backup setup? Are you able to work full-time New York hours and be on call for after-hours emergencies? What monthly salary are you looking for (USD)?

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter - UK Trade Businesses
description:
Full Pelt helps UK tradespeople get more work from Google - plumbers, electricians, roofers, heating engineers, locksmiths and the like. Most of them are brilliant at the job and haven't got time to sort out their Google profile or website, so they miss enquiries and lose work to the firm down the road.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll ring small trade businesses from a list we give you and offer them a free report showing where they're losing enquiries online. We call it the Jobs You're Missing report. If they're interested, you book a 20-minute call with Rob, the owner. You won't be closing sales or talking about prices.



This is a full-time role, 40 hours a week.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- You've done outbound cold calling before and you're fine hearing "no" a lot.

- You've sold to tradespeople or home-service businesses (HVAC, roofing, plumbing, solar, pest control, landscaping, cleaning). This matters more than anything else here. If your background is real estate or insurance, apply anyway and tell us how you'd adapt it.

- SEO, Google Business Profile or marketing agency sales is a big plus.

- Clear spoken English. You'll hear plenty of strong British accents and slang, so they shouldn't throw you.

- A quiet room, a good headset and reliable internet with a backup.

- You can work UK daytime hours, which are late afternoon into the night in Manila. The UK is 7 hours behind Manila until 25 October, then 8.



THE RULES WE WORK TO

- Follow the script and call only the people on the list we give you.

- Always say who you are and that you're calling from Full Pelt.

- If someone asks not to be called again, thank them, end the call and mark it straight away.

- Never promise results, rankings or a number of jobs.

- Call lists stay inside our system. No downloading, copying or keeping them.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word "Spanner" so we know you've read this far. Then send us:

1. A link to a 60 to 90 second voice recording (Vocaroo or Google Drive is fine) in which you pretend to ring a plumber in Manchester to offer a free report. It doesn't need to be perfect. We want to hear how you sound.

2. Which trades or local businesses you've called before, roughly how many calls you made a day, and how many appointments you booked a week.

3. Your hourly rate and the UK hours you can work.

In this role, you will help prepare accurate quantity takeoffs from construction drawings and specifications, focusing on earthwork, erosion control, and storm drainage. Your work will help the team prepare estimates more efficiently, evaluate more bid opportunities, and ensure important project details are not overlooked.

Organize takeoff results and supporting documentation for the estimating team.

Identify missing information, discrepancies, and details that may affect estimating accuracy.
