title: Social Media Management
description:
About the role

We are looking for a skilled, detail-driven social media manager to take our raw content and turn it into polished, high-quality posts across our channels. We will supply the photos and video footage. Your job is to edit it, write the copy, schedule everything and put it forward for approval before it goes live.

Alongside the day-to-day, we want you to build and own the system behind it: where content lives, how raw files are uploaded and labelled, and how a post moves from footage to published. The aim is a process that is simple, consistent and easy for anyone on the team to follow.

Key responsibilities

Editing

• Edit raw video into finished reels, stories and short-form content suited to each platform

• Edit and retouch photography to a consistent, high standard

• Add captions, subtitles, text overlays, music and transitions in line with our brand

• Produce correctly sized versions for each platform (e.g. 9:16, 4:5, 1:1)

• Keep a consistent visual style across every post

Copywriting

• Write captions, hooks and calls to action that match our tone of voice

• Research and apply relevant hashtags, tags and locations

• Adapt copy for each platform rather than posting the same text everywhere

• Proofread everything before it goes for approval

Scheduling and publishing

• Build and maintain a rolling content calendar, planned at least two weeks ahead

• Schedule all approved content using a scheduling tool

• Post at the times that perform best for our audience

• Make sure nothing goes live without sign-off

Approval workflow

• Submit each batch of content (edited asset, copy and planned date) for review by the founder

• Action feedback and amendments quickly and resubmit

• Keep a clear record of what is drafted, awaiting approval, approved and scheduled

Content organisation and process

• Design and set up a shared folder structure for all content (e.g. by brand, project, date and status: raw, in edit, approved, published)

• Create a simple process for how the team uploads raw videos and images, including file naming conventions and where each type of file goes

• Write a short guide so anyone supplying content knows exactly what to do

• Archive published content so it is easy to find and reuse later

• Review and improve the process as we grow

What we will provide

• Raw photography and video footage

• Brand guidelines, tone of voice and key messages

• Access to our social accounts and shared storage

• Timely feedback and approval

First 30 days

Within your first month we would expect you to:

1. Audit our current channels and content

2. Set up the folder structure, naming conventions and upload process, with a one-page guide for the team

3. Build the content calendar and approval workflow

4. Have the first two weeks of content edited, written and approved

Skills and experience

Essential

• Proven experience managing social media for a business or brand (please share a portfolio)

• Strong video editing skills (e.g. Premiere Pro, Final Cut, CapCut or similar)

• Strong photo editing skills (e.g. Lightroom, Photoshop)

• Excellent written English and a sharp eye for detail

• Experience with scheduling tools (e.g. Meta Business Suite, Later, Buffer, Metricool)

• Highly organised, reliable and able to work to deadlines with minimal supervision

Desirable

• Experience with Canva or similar design tools

• Experience setting up content systems in Google Drive, Dropbox, Notion or Trello

• Understanding of platform analytics and what drives engagement

• Experience in property, lifestyle, outdoor or premium brands

Platforms

Instagram,
, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube

!!We are looking for someone who:



Opens the dashboard every morning and finds problems before we do

!!Logs issues immediately — not after they are solved

!!Contacts suppliers proactively without being reminded

!!Sends a daily update without being asked

!!Brings solutions, not just problems



If you need constant guidance, this role is not for you. If you thrive working independently and take full ownership of your work — read on.



Your Responsibilities:

Daily Order Management

-Log every issue in the Daily Issue Tracker the 
nt you see it — not after it is resolved

Reporting

title: Senior Content Producer — Short/Long-Form Video & Graphic Carousels
description:
# Senior Content Producer — Short/Long-Form Video & Graphic Carousels

**Company:** Maverick Creative Group 

**Type:** Full-time, remote 

**Hours:** US Pacific Time, with required attendance at the daily review call, 9:00–11:00 AM PT 

**Reports to:** Operations Lead (daily)



---



## Overview

Maverick Creative Group is a California digital marketing agency. We build complete growth systems for American small businesses — websites, funnels, CRM automation, paid advertising, AI phone and chat assistants, and video and podcast production. Our clients are the people who keep American homes and neighborhoods running: contractors, plumbers, HVAC and roofing companies, real estate agents, and medical and dental clinics.



This is not a one-video-a-day editor role. It is a systematic media production role: design systems, asset batching, daily review syncs, and a clear standard for what "done" means. If you build production systems, hit high-volume benchmarks, and implement feedback fast, this role is for you.



---



## Role Breakdown

| Area | What you own |

| :--- | :--- |

| **Short-form video** | 20–25 finished Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts per day |

| **Graphic carousels** | Instagram, LinkedIn, and
 carousels of 5–10 slides |

| **Long-form video** | 10–30 minute podcasts, YouTube breakdowns, and software walkthroughs |

| **Synthetic media** | AI presenter clips and synthetic voiceovers when raw human footage isn't available |

| **Screen captures** | Vertical 9:16 desktop software demos |

| **Quality control** | Safe zones, spelling, pricing, and compliance |



---



## Responsibilities

1. **High-volume short-form reels:** Produce 20–25 finished short-form videos a day for Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts, with a target of 100+ approved assets per week at full ramp. You work from brand design systems and hook libraries, repurposing one source recording into multiple high-converting variants.

2. **Graphic carousels:** Design high-converting 5–10 slide carousels for Instagram, LinkedIn, and
 in 
, Photoshop, or Illustrator. Slide one is the hook, visual hierarchy is clean, and every slide stays on brand.

3. **Long-form editing:** Edit 10–30 minute podcasts, YouTube breakdowns, and software walkthroughs, including multi-cam sync, audio cleanup, and retention pacing. Carve each long recording into bite-sized Shorts and clips.

4. **Synthetic media:** Generate synthetic presenter clips in HeyGen/Descript when raw human clips aren't available. A generated presenter is always labelled as AI-generated where the platform requires it, and never appears as a fake customer or reviewer.

5. **Desktop screen captures:** Record and format vertical 9:16 demos of agency CRM workflows, with zoom-ins, voiceovers, and mobile-readable text.

6. **Lead-gen CTAs:** Design high-contrast end cards and keyword callouts (e.g., "Comment LAUNCH below") that feed our comment-automation funnels.

7. **Safe zones and QA:** Keep text and logos clear of platform UI buttons. Run a QA checklist on every piece before it goes to review: zero typos, prices exactly as approved sheets print them, and no unapproved claims.

8. **Reporting:** Name files systematically (e.g., `MCG_D07_video_ProductA_v1`), log every piece in the shared drive the same day, and attach supplied tracking links.



---



## Requirements

**Must have:**

- A strong portfolio containing short-form reels, graphic carousels, and long-form video edits (All 3 required).

- Proven daily output at volume, shown with real portfolio examples.

- Expert skill in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or CapCut.

- Skill in Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva.

- Hands-on experience with HeyGen/Descript, and desktop screen recording tools.

- Working knowledge of TikTok, Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and YouTube formats.

- Availability on US Pacific hours, including the 9:00–11:00 AM PT review call every day.

- A reliable machine, high-speed connection, quiet workspace, and 2FA on work accounts.



**Content standards you'll follow:**

- 9:16 at 1080×1920 for video, and 4:5 at 1080×1350 for carousels, unless specified otherwise.

- Brand colors: Navy `#0A1420`, Gold `#C9A24B`, Ivory `#ECEBE3`. Typography: Playfair Display (Headlines), Inter (Body).

- Licensed music only.

- Zero unapproved earnings, performance, or ranking claims.

- Every agency AI employee/avatar is clearly identified as AI.



---



## Hiring Process

1. **Portfolio & Resume Review:** Applications must include short-form reels, graphic carousels, and long-form video edits.

2. **Initial Interview:** 30 minutes covering output proof, template workflows, compliance judgment, and availability for daily PT review calls.

3. **Paid 5-Day Trial Batch:** You work from a source pack, deliver a defined batch of finished assets, and implement revisions from morning review calls. We evaluate:

   - **Speed:** Pieces delivered vs. target timeframe.

   - **Accuracy:** Zero compliance, pricing, or typo misses.

   - **Revisions:** Speed and completeness of feedback implementation.

   - **First-pass approval:** Benchmark of 90%+ assets approved without rework.



---



## Application Instructions

Apply with the subject line "Senior Content Producer — [Your Name]" and include:

1. Your resume.

2. Direct links to **at least three** short-form reels, **two** carousels, and **one** long-form video edit.

3. Answers to these questions:

   - How many finished short-form pieces do you produce on a typical day, and how long does each take you?

   - Can you attend a daily 9:00–11:00 AM US Pacific review call? What local time is that for you?

4. Your earliest start date.

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked

We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply.



How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days)

We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want.



Real Growth Example

One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly.



Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises)

This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment.



What Winning Looks Like

By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership.



If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.”



Who This Is NOT For

You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence.

You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level.

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure

You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side.

You are mass applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first.





Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs.

You hate corporate BS– endless meetings, vague goals, and politics – and would rather be rewarded for what you actually create.

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.



Comp & Growth

(All of this is written into your contract.)

Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial

• $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit.

• No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors.

Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside

• Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward.

• On top of base, you can earn:

$400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them).

$1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard.

• In practice, that means:

Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month

Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month

All bonuses are 100% KPI based (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture.



Training & Growth Investment (on top of pay)

We actively invest in making you a sharper teammate. Over time, we’ll put thousands of dollars into your development (courses, coaching, playbooks, and tools) that we choose together based on what will make you more effective in this seat.

We also protect uninterrupted deep work blocks for you every week (no random meetings, no Slack spam). You’re paid to ship outcomes, not sit in back to back Zoom calls.



Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to.

95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit.



Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.



How To Apply (24-Hour Test)

Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises)



If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are:

A short interview focused on your past execution.

A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit.



Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must:



Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine):

Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove from messy start to completion where you did most of the execution yourself, not just assigning tasks. Include at least one example of how you set your own deadlines and moved forward when other people were slow to respond.”

Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each.

Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders.

Q4: Below are 6 messy “tasks” we actually see (all dumped into one list):

– “Fix Asana, it’s a mess”

– “Seller lead texting follow up??”

– “Finance com/projections cadence d2 ”

– “Inventory backlog insane”

– “Need better reporting”

– “Update SOPs

In this role you will NOT have anyone to delegate to assume it’s just you and the Ops Manager.

In a Google Doc, please:



Rewrite these into clear tasks with: Owner (you or Ops Manager), Due Date (next 7–30 days), and a concrete Done Check + proof required. “Write your task descriptions as if you are committing: ‘I will do X by Y time. If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.”

Put them in the order you’d actually do them and explain why in 3–5 bullet points.



Link the Google Doc here (view access).



Spend no more than 30–45 minutes. If you can’t figure this out on your own, this role will be too hard in real life – that’s okay, just skip applying.



Attach your PDF resume/Google Drive link.

title: FACEBOOK ADS | AI VIDEO MAKER/EDITOR FOR E-COMMERCE BRAND
description:
We're looking for an AI video maker/editor who understands one thing clearly:

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche. Paid social is one of our main growth channels, which means video creative is not just "content" for us: it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels. This is a full-time role (40 hours per week).



This role is ideal for someone who is strong in direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

- AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

- Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.

You should know how to make videos that:

- Stop people in the first 1-3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

- Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice supports the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:

- HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

- ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

- Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

- At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use



Ideally, you also have experience with:

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

- Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

- Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

- Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

- Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.

If you're an AI video maker/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: QA Legal Assistant
description:
About the Opportunity



Are you a detail-driven legal professional with an exceptional eye for accuracy and a commitment to getting every detail right?

We are seeking a QA Legal Assistant to serve as a critical quality-control resource within our legal department. This role is ideal for someone who naturally catches inconsistencies, notices missing details others overlook, and takes pride in producing accurate, organized, and compliant work.

As a QA Legal Assistant, you will work behind the scenes to review, verify, and audit legal documentation, case files, administrative workflows, and critical deadlines before information moves forward.

Your attention to detail will help protect the firm from preventable errors, maintain compliance standards, and ensure our attorneys and legal teams have accurate information they can rely on.

If you thrive in an environment where precision, organization, consistency, and accountability matter, this could be an excellent opportunity for you.



Key Responsibilities



Legal Document Quality Control

- Review, proofread, and audit legal filings, contracts, correspondence, and other legal documents for accuracy and completeness.

- Verify names, dates, case information, attachments, citations, formatting, and other critical details.

- Maintain a high standard of accuracy and ensure documents are ready for submission or attorney review.

- Identify discrepancies, omissions, inconsistencies, and potential errors before they reach the next stage of the process.



Workflow & Compliance Audits

- Perform ongoing quality assurance reviews of specialized administrative workflows, including withdrawal-focused operations.

- Verify that required procedures, documentation, approvals, and compliance requirements are consistently followed.

- Identify process gaps and escalate issues that require attorney or management attention.

- Help maintain consistent quality standards across recurring workflows.



Case File & Data Auditing

- Conduct regular audits of digital case files, databases, and document management systems.

- Verify that records are complete, accurately categorized, properly documented, and organized.

- Identify missing or inconsistent information and coordinate corrections when necessary.

- Help ensure files remain organized and audit-ready.



Calendar & Deadline Verification

- Review department calendars and filing schedules for accuracy.

- Verify that court deadlines, discovery dates, follow-ups, and other critical dates are properly documented and tracked.

- Identify potential scheduling discrepancies or missing deadlines and promptly escalate concerns.



Case Information & Intake Review

- Review factual summaries, case notes, intake information, and supporting documentation for accuracy.

- Verify information before it is escalated to attorneys, clients, or external stakeholders.

- Ensure information is consistent across relevant systems and documents.



Qualifications & Requirements

- Minimum 1 year of experience in a legal environment.

- Experience with legal proofreading, quality assurance, compliance reviews, document auditing, or similar responsibilities.

- Associate's degree or equivalent professional administrative/legal experience.

- Strong understanding of legal procedures and administrative workflows.

- Experience reviewing or auditing withdrawal-focused workflows under strict compliance requirements is highly valued.

- Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to identify small errors, inconsistencies, and missing information.

- Highly organized with strong process-following and documentation skills.

- Excellent written English and proofreading abilities.

- Ability to work independently while maintaining consistent quality and productivity.

- Strong judgment when handling confidential and attorney-client privileged information.

- Comfortable working with digital case management systems, databases, document management platforms, and remote-work technology.

- Ability to consistently meet deadlines while maintaining a high standard of accuracy.



What Makes This Role Important

Quality control is more than proofreading—it is a critical part of protecting the integrity of our legal operations.

In this role, you will help ensure that the right information is in the right place, deadlines are accurately tracked, documents are complete, and processes are followed correctly.



Your work will provide attorneys and legal teams with greater confidence that the information they rely on has been carefully reviewed and verified.



Schedule

Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST

Fully Remote





How to Apply

Please submit your resume highlighting your experience in legal quality control, compliance, proofreading, document review, case management, or administrative auditing.



Candidates with a strong track record of accuracy, organization, and attention to detail are encouraged to apply.

title: Logistics Virtual Assistant 30-day paid trial · Remote · 15 hrs/week · USD $7.50/hr
description:
Logistics Virtual Assistant

30-day paid trial · Remote · 15 hrs/week · USD $7.50/hr

Chameleon Science Pty Ltd · Australia



About the role

Chameleon Science sells research reagents to laboratories across Australia and New Zealand, sourced

from suppliers in the US, Europe and China. We handle 7–10 customer orders a week. Every order has

to be quoted, ordered from the supplier, cleared through Australian biosecurity, held at the right

temperature, delivered and invoiced.

You will run that process end to end, following our Order Logistics SOP. The role starts with logistics and

can grow into general admin.

We are looking for someone who follows a process carefully and then tells us how to make it better. If

you spot something that does not add up, we want you to stop and ask rather than push it through.

What you will own

Every order, from the customer's first request to delivery:

1. Quote the customer. Build quotes in Xero with correct pricing, freight (standard, blue ice or dry ice)

and lead time. Send them and log the deal in Pipedrive.

2. Take in orders. Check each customer PO against the quote, acknowledge it the same day, and

choose the shipping route.

3. Order from the supplier. Raise purchase orders in Xero in the supplier's currency. Track

confirmations, backorders and ship dates.

4. Prepare import paperwork. Send suppliers our import permit and manufacturer's declaration

template. Check the signed declaration matches the permit word for word.

5. Pre-clear and track. Send FedEx the clearance documents, track inbound shipments daily, and

answer customs queries the same day.

6. Arrange delivery. Brief our Sydney logistics partner, book couriers before the daily cutoff, and

manage cold-chain and dry-ice shipments.

7. Invoice. Send one Xero invoice per order at dispatch, with courier and tracking number.

8. Close out. Record delivery, keep Pipedrive and the shipment spreadsheet current, and enter

supplier bills in Xero.

Across every step:

• Answer overnight supplier questions first thing, before US and EU cutoffs.

• Check the orders@, accounts@ and info@ inboxes every day.

• Keep customers informed of ETAs and delays before they have to ask.

• Flag anything that does not match — prices, cartons, paperwork — before acting on it.

What stays with Kathryn during the trial

These decisions do not route to you in the first 30 days:

• Manufacturers declarations — you check them, Kathryn approves each one before the supplier is

told to ship.

• Courier and freight spend — ask before booking or approving.

• Permit wording for new product types — checked case by case.

• Overdue-invoice chasing — not part of the trial.

• FedEx import freight and duty invoices — Kathryn codes these in Xero.

Logins to FedEx, Toll, Team Global Express, Logistics 360, Xero, Pipedrive and the shipment

spreadsheet are set up on day one.

How hiring works

Step 1 — Application

Send a short note covering your logistics or order-processing experience and the systems you have

used, plus a 2-minute video introducing yourself.

Put DRY ICE as the first word of your subject line. Applications without it are not read — this role is

about reading instructions carefully, and this is the first test.

Step 2 — Paid test project

Shortlisted applicants complete a paid 2-hour task built from a real order: check a set of order

documents, quote it, and tell us what to do next. Paid at the hourly rate above regardless of outcome.

Step 3 — 30-day paid trial

A paid, fixed-term engagement. It is a fair test both ways: you see whether the work suits you, and we

see whether you can run orders with less and less help.

The 30 days

Week Focus Done when

1 Learn the SOP, systems and partners.

Shadow live orders.



You can explain each step and know what

routes back to Kathryn.



2 Run quotes, PO intake and supplier POs, with

Kathryn checking.



Quotes and POs go out correct and same-

day.

3 Run import paperwork, tracking and dispatch,

with Kathryn checking.



Shipments pre-cleared and dispatched with

no missed cutoffs.



4 Run the full process end to end. Propose

improvements.



Most orders need no correction, and you

have proposed at least one SOP

improvement.



At the end we review together against four measures:

• Orders processed correctly from quote to invoice.

• Supplier and courier cutoffs met.

• Pipedrive, Xero and the shipment spreadsheet matching reality at the end of each day.

• Problems flagged early, with a clear question or a suggested fix.

title: Long-Form YouTube Vlog Editor (+ Short Clips)
description:
We're a small team working with a German lifestyle creator. She films long-form vlogs – trips, days out, behind the scenes – around 4–6 per month, for YouTube.



We're looking for an editor who takes these vlogs to a clearly better level and turns each one into a set of short clips.



What you'll do



- Edit 30–40 min of 4K raw footage into an 8–12 min vlog (YouTube version + a second version with a different intro)

- Cut as many 9:16 clips as the footage allows for Reels, TikTok and Shorts

- Create 3–5 thumbnail options per vlog

- Bring your own ideas for structure, pacing and the channel



What you need

- Real long-form YouTube experience (videos of 10+ min)

- Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

- A feel for storytelling: hook/teaser at the start, chapters, rhythm between wide shots, people and details

- Clean, consistent color (footage is standard, not log)

- Stable internet – raw footage is about 10–12 GB per vlog

- Reliable with deadlines, good English



How it works

1. Apply here. We'll send you a link to our application page (one page, ~15 min, incl. a short intro video).

2. Paid trial: one real vlog incl. clips and thumbnails.

3. After that: a fixed rate per vlog or a monthly rate.



To show you read this: you'll need the word HOOK on the application page.

title: Experienced AI Writer
description:
The Ad Firm is a top digital marketing agency headquartered in Southern California that serves clients nationwide. We are seeking an AI Content Writer to join our growing content team. This is not a traditional content writing role. We are looking for someone who already writes content optimized for AI-powered search platforms and generative engines. 



The right candidate should be working at a marketing agency right now, with at least two years of experience managing multiple projects at once. This is a remote position for The Ad Firm. Workdays are from 8 am to 5 pm PST, with the possibility of flexible hours after the initial probationary period. 



We are a digital marketing agency that has consistently grown our clients' businesses online since 2009. We have been awarded numerous times for our output work and the atmosphere of our team. We specialize in helping companies grow and tracking the success we bring to each of our clients.





Role Purpose:

Write and optimize content that performs across both traditional search engines and AI-powered platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Claude. You will work under our Content Manager and alongside our SEO managers and Client Success Managers to produce content that is strategically structured to be cited and surfaced by generative AI models, not just ranked by Google.



The right fit will understand the difference between writing for traditional search and writing for generative search, and will be able to do both. You should be comfortable switching between industries and client voices, and confident using AI tools as part of your workflow at an advanced level. Writing efficiently and in a timely manner is a must, as well as having perfect grammar and spelling in American English.





Required Qualifications:

- 2-4 years of creating SEO-driven content at a marketing agency or in-house team

- Portfolio that includes content cited or surfaced by AI platforms (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews), not just traditionally ranked content

- Working knowledge of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) strategies

- Advanced prompt engineering skills with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Perplexity, beyond basic drafting and rewording

- Understanding of how large language models process, extract, and cite content

- Experience with entity-based SEO and topical authority structuring (pillar pages, content clusters, supporting content)

- Familiarity with schema markup and structured data at the content level

- Ability to fact-check and validate AI-generated content against real-world sources to maintain EEAT standards

- Familiar with traditional SEO best practices (keyword strategy, header hierarchy, internal linking, on-page optimization)

- Familiar with conversion best practices

- Exceptional editorial and self-editing skills

- Excellent time management and the ability to handle multiple client projects simultaneously

- Works equally well independently or as part of a team

- Welcomes feedback from team, supervisors, and clients

- Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field preferred





Responsibilities:

- Write original content using answer-first formatting, semantic structuring, and clear entity signals designed for AI citation and traditional search ranking

- Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity) at an advanced level for research, content structuring, drafting, and quality refinement

- Interpret and apply content briefs, keyword assignments, and client guidelines across multiple industries and content types (blog posts, service pages, product pages, press releases, page titles and descriptions)

- Audit existing content for AI readiness and recommend restructuring for improved GEO/AEO performance

- Optimize on-page elements including header hierarchy, internal linking, and structured data alignment

- Review and refine AI-generated drafts for factual accuracy, tone consistency, brand voice, and editorial quality

- Conduct research to verify all content claims against the client's actual services, credentials, and website

- Create original and dynamic content that supports the client's brand voice, overarching brand vision, and the audience it serves

- Stay current on how AI search platforms discover, process, and cite content





Why Join Us:

- Work with a diverse range of clients and industries.

- Collaborative, fast-paced, and growth-focused agency culture.

- Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.

- Professional development support and SEO tool access.

- Flexible remote work options.

- 2 weeks Paid Time-Off

- Paid Sick Leave

- 8 Paid Holidays

- Health Insurance

title: Senior Construction Accountant (QuickBooks Online, Job Costing, Catch-Up Work)
description:
We're a US commercial landscape and irrigation contractor working in multiple states. We need a senior accountant who can take full ownership of our accounting with minimal supervision: bring our books current, keep them accurate, and build better financial systems as we grow. This is not an entry-level bookkeeping role.



Your first priority: our books are more than two years behind. You'll lead the catch-up: categorize and reconcile past bank and card activity, clean up AP and AR, fix job costing, and get everything ready for our CPA.



Ongoing responsibilities:

- Day-to-day bookkeeping, plus monthly bank and credit card reconciliations

- Accounts payable: entering vendor bills and scheduling payments

- Invoicing, progress billing, retainage tracking and collections follow-up

- Job costing by project, and reports that show job profitability

- Running payroll for seasonal crews (layoffs and rehires), including certified/prevailing-wage payroll on public jobs

- Working with our QuickBooks Payroll Elite team to keep payroll and payroll taxes compliant in every state we work in

- Multi-state sales and use tax

- Monthly financial statements, and year-end work with our CPA

- Advising on and setting up better processes, controls and reporting



Requirements:

- A degree in accounting or a related field

- 10+ years of hands-on accounting experience (10-20 years preferred), with construction or contractor clients (job costing, progress billing, retainage). E-commerce- or retail-only backgrounds will not be considered.

- At least one large catch-up/cleanup project

- Able to work independently, take ownership, and manage the accounting function without being micromanaged

- Strong QuickBooks Online skills (experience with QBO Advanced is a plus)

- Comfortable with Excel, Google Sheets/Drive, Outlook/Microsoft 365, Adobe Acrobat and bank portals; 
 and AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok) are a plus

- At least 2-4 hours of overlap daily with US Mountain Time

- Clear written English and reliable internet



To apply, start with the word "RETAINAGE" and answer:

1. How many years have you worked as an accountant/bookkeeper, and how many of those were with construction or contractor clients? Name the types of contractors.

2. Describe the largest catch-up project you've done: how far behind were the books, and how did you approach it?

3. Tell us about a time job costs in QuickBooks didn't match what actually happened on a project. What was wrong, and how did you fix it?

4. Walk us through how you set up job costing for a contractor client in QuickBooks Online (projects, items, classes, or whatever you used), and why you set it up that way.

5. Have you run certified or prevailing-wage payroll? Which states?

6. What hours (in Philippine time) can you work, and are you looking for full-time or part-time?

7. What is your expected hourly rate in USD?

title: SEO Lead
description:
About Jumper Media



Jumper Media helps local businesses dominate their markets through Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, and AI-driven search strategies. We're growing quickly and are looking for an experienced SEO Team Lead to help us deliver exceptional results while continuing to improve how we operate.



This is not a traditional SEO role. If your experience is primarily in ecommerce, SaaS, or enterprise SEO, this probably isn't the right fit. We're looking for someone who is passionate about Local SEO and excited about where AI is taking search.



About the Role



As an SEO Team Lead, you'll own a portfolio of local SEO clients from strategy through execution. You'll work directly with clients, collaborate with teammates, and continuously improve the processes that help our clients rank across Google Maps, organic search, and AI-powered search experiences.



If you're someone who enjoys testing new ideas, using AI to work smarter, and helping clients grow, we'd love to meet you.



What You'll Do:



- Develop and execute Local SEO strategies for a portfolio of clients.

- Optimize Google Business Profiles, websites, citations, and local link building campaigns.

- Improve client visibility across Google Maps, Search, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

- Analyze campaign performance and turn data into actionable recommendations.

- Meet with clients to explain strategy, review results, and build strong relationships.

- Manage multiple client projects while maintaining a high level of quality and organization.

- Use AI tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and campaign execution.

- Share ideas, test new strategies, and help improve internal SEO processes.



What Success Looks Like:



- Clients improve rankings across Google Maps, Search, and AI search experiences.

- Clients trust your recommendations and enjoy working with you.

- You successfully manage multiple client accounts while delivering projects on time.

- You help improve internal SEO processes through testing, documentation, and collaboration.

- You continue growing your Local SEO expertise and help raise the level of the team.



What We're Looking For



Required Experience:



- Intermediate to advanced experience with Local SEO.

- Strong knowledge of Google Business Profile optimization.

- Experience with local citations and local link building.

- Understanding of AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization).

- Strong analytical skills and confidence working with SEO data and reporting.

- Experience managing multiple client accounts.

- Comfortable leading client meetings and communicating SEO strategy.

- Experience integrating AI into daily workflows to improve efficiency.



Soft Skills:



- Self starter who takes initiative.

- Confident decision maker who doesn't need constant direction.

- Takes ownership and treats the business like it's their own.

- Collaborative and open to constructive feedback.

- Strong communicator with teammates and clients.

- Curious and committed to continuous learning.



Preferred Qualifications:



- Experience with Digital PR for local businesses.

- Multi-location or franchise SEO experience.

- Experience recovering suspended Google Business Profiles.

- Experience recovering websites from algorithm penalties or significant ranking losses.



Tools You'll Use:



- Google Workspace

- Ahrefs

- Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

- Google Tag Manager (GTM)

- Google Search Console (GSC)

- Jumper Local

- Experience with platforms such as BrightLocal or Local Falcon is a plus.



Why Join Jumper Media?



We're building a team that moves fast, embraces AI, and is obsessed with continuous improvement. We look for people who take ownership, challenge the status quo, and are excited to help shape the future of Local SEO.



If you're passionate about Local SEO, excited about AI, and want to help build something special, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Social Media Multimedia Designer (AI-Enabled)
description:
Jumper Media is hiring a Social Media Multimedia Designer to support our social media and marketing content for client accounts. This role covers both static design and short-form video — Instagram statics, carousels, Reels/TikTok, and social-first layouts — for a fast-paced digital agency working with U.S.-based clients.



We're prioritizing strong creative fundamentals and social media judgment first. AI-assisted workflows are part of how we work and help our team move faster and produce better work, but they're a tool in service of good design and editing — not a substitute for it.



What You'll Do:

- Produce a high volume of social content weekly across static and video formats

- Create Instagram statics, carousels, Reels/TikTok, video cutdowns, social-first layouts, and occasional YouTube content + thumbnails

- Interpret brand guidelines and content briefs independently

- Use AI tools where they genuinely improve speed or quality (image generation, captioning, transcript-based editing, cutdowns) while keeping output natural and on-brand

- Self-QA all deliverables before they go out

- Collaborate with the team via Slack/Trello/Drive, managing overlapping deadlines

- Grow toward owning full account output — design and video — independently



What We're Looking For:

- 2+ years in social media design and/or video editing (agency or content-marketing background preferred)

- Strong design/editing fundamentals — layout, composition, pacing, storytelling

- A portfolio spanning both static/carousel design and short-form video

- Proficiency with at least one design tool (Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Figma) and one editing tool (Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro)

- Comfort with AI-assisted workflows, or strong willingness to learn

- Available during PST business hours (night shift, Philippines)



Details:

Independent contractor, ~30 hrs/week, starting at $5/hr with room for rate increases based on performance.



To Apply: 

 
 with your portfolio (design + video required) and a short intro about your experience.

title: Customer Service Specialist (Part-Time) – E-Commerce / Fashion
description:
Customer Service Specialist (Part-Time) – E-Commerce / Fashion



Remote | Monday–Saturday | 4–6 Hours per Day | Growth Opportunity



 About Us



We are a growing e-commerce company operating four fashion dropshipping stores in the European market.



Our stores currently generate approximately 3-5K in combined daily revenue and we are continuously working on expanding our operations.



We are looking for a  proactive, confident and solution-oriented Customer Service Specialist who takes ownership of customer inquiries, handles challenging situations professionally and helps us deliver a better customer experience.



This is not just a position for answering
s. We need someone who genuinely cares about customers, takes initiative and actively works towards resolving issues.



Your Responsibilities



**1. Inbound Customer Support**

- Handle incoming customer
s across our four fashion stores.

- Respond professionally to inquiries about orders, shipping, tracking, returns, refunds and product issues.

- Manage complaints and difficult customer situations confidently.

- Offer suitable solutions while balancing customer satisfaction and company profitability.

- Follow our internal SOPs and customer service guidelines.



2. Proactive Outbound Communication

- Review our internal Excel/Google Sheets tracking systems daily.

- Identify orders requiring customer updates or follow-ups.

- Proactively contact customers regarding shipping delays, delivery issues, replacements and outstanding cases.

- Follow up on unresolved tickets until a solution has been reached.

- Ensure no customer inquiry or open case is forgotten.



**3. Supply Chain Coordination**

- Work closely with our Supply Chain Manager.

- Review supplier updates and order statuses daily.

- Coordinate customer communication regarding missing parcels, delayed orders, damaged products and replacements.

- Maintain accurate records and update tracking sheets consistently.



**4. Trustpilot & Customer Satisfaction**

- Actively support our efforts to improve Trustpilot ratings and overall customer satisfaction.

- Review negative feedback and identify customer cases requiring attention.

- Proactively follow up with dissatisfied customers to resolve complaints.

- Encourage satisfied customers to share honest reviews where appropriate.

- Help identify recurring issues and recommend improvements.



**5. Refunds, Returns & Disputes**

- Handle refund and return requests according to company policies.

- Focus on customer retention and appropriate solutions.

- Identify potential chargeback risks and escalate sensitive cases.

- Ensure all refunds and resolutions are accurately documented.



### What We're Looking For



- Previous customer service experience, preferably in **e-commerce or dropshipping**.

- Excellent written English communication skills.

- Strong problem-solving and negotiation skills.

- Confident, professional and empathetic communication style.

- Ability to handle demanding or frustrated customers.

- Experience with Shopify is highly preferred.

- Comfortable working with Excel and Google Sheets.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

- Proactive mindset — you don't wait for instructions when you identify an issue.

- Reliable, accountable and comfortable working in a fast-growing environment.



**Experience with Zoho Desk, Trustpilot or fashion e-commerce is a plus.**



### Working Hours



- **Monday to Saturday**

- Approximately **4–6 hours per day**

- Remote position

- Working hours may increase as our stores and order volume grow.

- Long-term collaboration preferred.



### What We Offer



- Long-term opportunity in a growing e-commerce company.

- Fully remote working environment.

- Established SOPs and internal processes.

- Direct collaboration with our Supply Chain Manager.

- Opportunity to take on more responsibilities as the company scales.

- Competitive compensation based on experience.



### How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your previous customer service experience, particularly in e-commerce.

3. The tools you have worked with (Shopify, Zoho Desk, Google Sheets, etc.).

4. Your availability from Monday to Saturday.

5. Your expected hourly or monthly salary.



**Bonus:** Briefly explain how you would handle an angry customer demanding a full refund because their order has been delayed.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates proactively and genuinely wants to help us build a stronger customer experience.

title: META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR
description:
META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR

We're looking for an AI video generator/editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:



AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to make videos that:



Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds

Make the problem feel real and urgent

Show the product clearly and persuasively

Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase

You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes… then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:



Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

Can create multiple ad variations quickly

Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good

We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:



HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use

You also have experience with:



Meta/Facebook ad creatives

Short-form paid social videos

Long-form VSLs or sales videos

Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Competitive compensation based on experience

Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives

The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

Clear creative direction and fast feedback

Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.



If you're an AI video generator/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.



TO PROCEED WITH YOUR APPLICATION, PLEASE FILL THIS GOOGLE FORM:

title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
Senior Operations Manager, Home Care (Remote, Philippines-based)



OPA Home Care is a licensed home care agency in Atlanta, Georgia, and part of a small group of healthcare companies I founded and own. Our caregivers serve clients in their homes every day. Our scheduling and coordination team works remotely from the Philippines. I am hiring a senior operations manager to watch that team throughout the US day and make sure every piece of work meets the OPA standard.



THE JOB

A client waiting for a caregiver cannot see our schedule, and the company cannot watch its own team. Somebody has to look at the work while it is happening, find what is missing, and get it fixed before it reaches a client. That is this job.



You will:

- Watch open shifts, call-outs, and unconfirmed visits from the start of the US day to the end, and make sure each one has an owner and gets closed.

- Check the schedulers' and coordinators' work against the standard every day, and tell them in writing where it falls short.

- Review recorded calls and
s. Every call and
 at OPA is recorded and transcribed.

- Follow up on every open item, every time, until it is closed. Sending a message does not close an item.

- Close each day with a written report: what is still open, who owns it, and when it will be done.

- Tell me before a deadline when something is going to be late.



THE OPA STANDARD

We hire and coach on five standards. You must meet all five, and you must hold the team to them.

1. Attention to detail. You catch the shift with no caregiver, the wrong date, and the note that says "covered" when the visit is not covered.

2. Self-starter. You find the problem before anyone assigns it to you.

3. Follow-up. Every item, every time, without fail. If you raised something and nothing happened, you raise it again.

4. Coachability. When you are corrected, your next piece of work shows the correction.

5. Lagniappe. A little bit extra: one more call, one more check, done because the client needed it.



WHO FAILS IN THIS JOB

If "I already messaged them" sounds like a finished task to you, you will fail here. If you would rather not correct a coordinator who has been here longer than you, or you report Monday's problem on Friday, this job will be miserable for you.

Coaching here means telling someone exactly where their work falls short of the standard, showing them what meeting it looks like, and checking the next piece of work, as many times as it takes. It is hard and often harsh.



WHAT YOU NEED

- At least two years in operations, scheduling, or coordination for a US home care agency. Experience supervising a scheduling or coordination team is strongly preferred.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Experience with a home care scheduling system. We use AxisCare. WellSky (ClearCare) or AlayaCare experience also counts.

- Availability for the full US Eastern business day. Some days run longer.

- A reliable computer and internet connection, with a backup for each.



PAY

USD 1,500 per month, paid in two equal payments of USD 750 on the 15th and on the last day of each month. Full-time and long-term. This is the offer. There is no range.



HOW TO APPLY

Read every instruction. Following them is part of the test.

- Use this subject line: Senior Ops Manager, your full name, and the word Lagniappe.

- Include a link to your resume that opens without requesting access. We will check it.

- No cover letter. Answer the four questions below, numbered, in under 700 words total.

- Applications that skip a question or use a different subject line will not be read.

- We may reply with one follow-up question. Answer it within 24 hours.



QUESTION 1

Below is an end-of-day note a scheduler sent to her manager. OPA rule: a caregiver whose credentialing is not complete may not work after her 30th day.



"Tuesday wrap-up. All 38 shifts for Wednesday are confirmed. Two call-outs today, both handled. Maria R. called out of the Johnson visit (8 a.m. to 2 p.m.) and Ana T. covered it. Joseph L. called out of the Patel visit (2 p.m. to 8 p.m.). Still looking, I will update. Ana T. also picks up the Williams visit on Wednesday. Wednesday is her 31st day, and her credentialing paperwork is almost done. Mrs. Williams' daughter called about a visit she says nobody showed up for on Monday. I told her we would look into it."



List every problem in this note. Then write the exact message you would send the scheduler, and say what you would do yourself before the US day ends.



QUESTION 2

Describe a time someone senior to you corrected your work. What exactly was wrong, what did you change, and how did your next piece of work show the change?



QUESTION 3

Describe an item you had to follow up on three or more times before it was closed. Who owned it, what kept it open, and how did it finally close? Give the dates.



QUESTION 4

Tell us about something you did in your last job that nobody asked you to do. What did it take, and what did it change for the company or the client?

title: Women only- short form video editor and social media content assistant
description:
Job Opening: WOMEN ONLY - Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media Content Assistant



Remote | Part-time | Long-term collaboration | Based in the Philippines



About the role



I’m looking for a reliable, creative and proactive video editor and social media assistant to help me stay consistent on Instagram and TikTok.



I create Dutch-speaking content around lifestyle, personal development, business, content creation and entrepreneurship. I want to build a strong and consistent online presence without having to manage every editing, planning and posting task myself.



I’m looking for someone who can do more than just edit videos. I want someone who thinks along with me, spots opportunities, suggests content ideas and helps me turn the content I already create into as much valuable content as possible.



The goal is simple: create a consistent content system that allows us to publish regularly without me having to think about every single post.



1. Video editing



Your main responsibility will be editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok.



Your tasks include:



* Editing talking-head videos in Dutch.

* Creating engaging hooks, adding captions and highlighting important words.

* Removing unnecessary pauses, filler words, mistakes and repetitive sections.

* Adding relevant B-roll, zoom-ins, transitions, sound effects and background music when appropriate.

* Improving pacing, storytelling and viewer retention.

* Creating clean, professional and visually engaging videos that match my personal brand.

* Exporting videos in the correct format and quality for Instagram and TikTok.

* Maintaining consistent editing quality across all content.



Important: My videos are spoken in Dutch. You must be able to understand spoken Dutch well enough to identify the key message, edit accurately, recognize important moments and create meaningful clips. Captions must also be accurate in Dutch. Automatic captions must always be checked and corrected.



You do not necessarily need to speak Dutch fluently, but you must demonstrate that you can work accurately with Dutch-language content.



2. Content repurposing



I want to get more value out of every video I record.



For example, one longer video could become several shorter videos, each focusing on a different point, lesson, story or strong hook.



Your responsibilities include:



* Identifying the strongest moments in longer recordings.

* Turning longer videos into multiple standalone short-form clips.

* Finding different hooks and angles within the same recording.

* Making sure each clip has a clear message and makes sense on its own.

* Suggesting alternative edits or opening hooks when they could improve the content.

* Avoiding repetitive clips that communicate essentially the same thing.



The goal is not simply to produce as many clips as possible. The goal is to create as many useful, engaging and relevant pieces of content as possible from the original footage.



3. Content batching and planning



I want us to work in content batches instead of handling every video as a separate task.



This means helping me organize and prepare content in advance so that we can maintain a consistent posting schedule.



Your responsibilities include:



* Helping organize raw footage and content ideas.

* Working with me to prepare content batches.

* Keeping track of which videos need editing, approval or publishing.

* Creating a clear content calendar.

* Suggesting relevant content ideas based on my existing content, audience and goals.

* Identifying opportunities to turn recurring themes into content series.

* Helping repurpose existing footage when I have limited time to record new videos.



I will provide the original footage, context and overall direction. I expect you to help turn that material into a structured, manageable content workflow.



4. Instagram and TikTok management



Once videos are edited and approved, you will help prepare and publish the content.



Tasks include:



* Preparing and scheduling approved videos on Instagram and TikTok.

* Writing or suggesting relevant captions.

* Suggesting suitable calls to action.

* Researching relevant keywords and hashtags when appropriate.

* Checking that videos, captions and covers are ready before publishing.

* Maintaining the agreed posting schedule.

* Keeping track of published content and upcoming posts.

* Flagging any technical issues or missing information before the scheduled publication date.



You must be comfortable working with social media scheduling and publishing tools. Access to my accounts will be provided through an agreed, secure process.



5. Creative thinking and initiative



This is a very important part of the role.



I don’t want someone who simply waits for instructions for every small task. I want someone who can think independently and identify opportunities to improve our content.



For example:



* “This part of the video would work better as a separate Reel.”

* “We could create three different hooks for this topic.”

* “This video would make a good recurring content series.”

* “We have enough footage here for next week’s posts.”

* “This editing style could make the message clearer.”

* “We should prepare these videos in advance to stay consistent.”



I value creative thinking, attention to detail, organization and solutions rather than just identifying problems.



You are encouraged to share ideas and recommendations. I will make the final decisions on content direction and brand positioning.



6. Requirements



I’m looking for someone who:



* Has experience editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok.

* Can accurately understand spoken Dutch in video recordings.

* Understands short-form storytelling, hooks, pacing and audience retention.

* Is comfortable repurposing long-form content into shorter clips.

* Is organized, dependable and able to meet deadlines.

* Apply agreed feedback to future edits to reduce repeated revisions.

* Suggest improvements when you see an opportunity.



I want us to build a reliable system that becomes more efficient over time.



8. Application instructions



To apply, please provide:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

2. Your video-editing portfolio, especially talking-head videos, Reels or TikToks.

3. Examples of videos where you have edited captions, hooks and short-form clips.

7. A brief explanation of how you would turn one 10-minute talking-head video into multiple engaging short-form videos.



Please also include the word CONTENT SYSTEM at the beginning of your application so I know you have read the full job description.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small, paid editing test using Dutch-language footage. The test will help us evaluate your editing quality, understanding of the spoken content, caption accuracy and ability to identify strong short-form clips.



I’m looking for a dependable creative partner who wants to help build a consistent and effective content workflow over the long term.

title: Ecommerce Operations Coordinator | Logistics & Supply Chain
description:
We are a growing North American physical-product ecommerce business looking for an experienced Ecommerce Operations Coordinator to keep production, logistics, inventory, and warehouse follow-up organized and moving.



This is a remote, part-time role with potential for a long-term working relationship. You will work closely with our Operations Manager, handle routine work within our SOPs, investigate issues, and bring clear recommendations when decisions or approvals are needed.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Track production and purchase orders: follow up with suppliers on milestones, quantities, samples, payment stages, and written commitments. Flag delays early and keep trackers current.

• Coordinate inspections and freight: organize inspection timelines and reports, follow up on corrections, compare freight options, coordinate approved bookings, and track shipments and delivery dates.

• Keep inventory accurate: reconcile Shopify, warehouse, and 3PL records; investigate discrepancies; track incoming stock and stockout risks; and coordinate approved inventory transfers.

• Follow through with warehouses and 3PLs: resolve receiving and fulfillment issues, gather supporting information, and make sure action items reach completion.

• Support operational systems: maintain accurate Shopify inventory and location records, support retail or marketplace vendor portals, and organize shipping, claims, and compliance documents.

• Keep work organized: maintain ClickUp tasks, operational trackers, checklists, and SOPs so the team can see what is complete, what is delayed, and what needs a decision.



HOW WE WORK



We value someone who follows up proactively and investigates before escalating. When an issue needs approval, bring the facts, what you have already checked, realistic options, your recommendation, and the deadline for a decision.



You will own routine coordination and execution. Our Operations Manager will retain oversight and approval of significant cost and logistics decisions. We value clear communication, sound judgment, and honest updates when something goes wrong.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Ideally 2–3 years of relevant experience in physical-product ecommerce operations, supply chain, logistics, production, inventory, or warehouse coordination.

• Practical experience with suppliers, purchase orders, shipments, inventory records, or 3PLs. Experience working with factories in China or elsewhere in Asia is an advantage.

• Strong organization, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through across multiple deadlines and time zones.

• Clear written English and the ability to explain an issue and recommend the next step.

• Confidence using spreadsheets and learning operational systems.



Relevant tools include Shopify, ClickUp, Airtable, Google Sheets or Excel, warehouse or 3PL systems such as ShipHero, QIMA, freight portals, and DSCO / Rithum. You do not need experience with every tool; relevant hands-on experience and the ability to learn matter more.



HOURS



• Remote, part-time: around 15 hours per week initially.

• Flexible working hours, with 1–2 hours of overlap with Toronto / Eastern Time mornings on regular working days.

• We plan to begin with a paid 3–4 week trial, with potential for an ongoing role and increased hours as the business grows.



APPLICATION PROCESS



Apply here:



The form asks about work you personally handled, includes two short operational scenarios, and requests a simple 2–3 minute introduction video. Keep your answers specific and concise; no presentation or lengthy proposal is needed.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview, followed by a paid trial if selected.

title: Head Of Acquisition
description:

Systems and process architecture

Quality and training at scale

A-players only

• Enforce a tight performance bar: short improvement plans, fast exits. The roster holds only proven performers at every stage of scale.

Leadership and reporting

• Manage and develop the Director of Acquisitions (Adrian) and the team lead layer.

• Deliver a weekly operating report to the founder: activity, quality, pipeline, deals closed, and roster moves.



Ideal Candidate Profile

• 2+ years leading outbound call center or BPO operations, including scaling a telecom or similar cold calling operation past 30 agents.

• Has personally built the systems, not just used them: QA programs, workforce management and schedule adherence, activity dashboards, and anti-time-theft controls.
