title: META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR
description:
META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR

We're looking for an AI video generator/editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:



AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to make videos that:



Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds

Make the problem feel real and urgent

Show the product clearly and persuasively

Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase

You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes… then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:



Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

Can create multiple ad variations quickly

Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good

We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:



HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use

You also have experience with:



Meta/Facebook ad creatives

Short-form paid social videos

Long-form VSLs or sales videos

Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

**Marketing & Social Media Specialist**



**Company:** Harvest & Give Olive Oil Co.



**Position Type:** Part-Time / Contract (Flexible / Hybrid)

 **About Us**



Harvest & Give Olive Oil Co. connects authentic Mediterranean tradition with community giving. Rooted in our shared Sicilian and Greek heritage, we provide ultra-premium, cold-pressed olive oil to power meaningful fundraising campaigns for schools, sports teams, charities, and community organizations.



#### **Position Overview**



We are looking for a creative, energetic **Marketing & Social Media Specialist** to lead our digital presence, build brand awareness, and drive engagement across our fundraising programs. You will craft compelling campaigns that tell our story—highlighting our rich heritage, healthy lifestyle values, and impactful community partnerships.



**Key Responsibilities**



* **Social Media Management:** Create, schedule, and manage engaging content across Instagram,
, TikTok, and LinkedIn.

* **Campaign Strategy:** Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns promoting seasonal fundraising drives and institutional partnerships.

* **Content Creation:** Produce high-quality photos, short-form video reels, and compelling copy that highlight our premium olive oil, recipes, and fundraising success stories.

* **Community Engagement:** Interact with followers, respond to inquiries, and build relationships with school committees, non-profit organizers, and food/lifestyle influencers.

* *
 Marketing & Collateral:** Design visually appealing promotional flyers, digital campaign guides, and
 newsletters for our fundraising partners.



**Qualifications & Skills**



* Proven experience managing social media accounts and creating content for food, lifestyle, or non-profit/fundraising brands.

* Proficiency with design and video tools (e.g., Canva, Adobe Express, CapCut).

* Strong copywriting skills with a warm, storytelling tone.

* Familiarity with
 marketing platforms and basic digital analytics.

* Passion for community, culture, and healthy living.

, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid platforms

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Paid social is one of our main growth channels. Video creative is not just "content" for us, it is one of the biggest drivers of the business. We need someone who knows that a good ad doesn't just look nice: it stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



The right person understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



VIDEO TYPES

- AI avatar ads. Realistic avatars from photos, animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs, on scripts we provide.

- Pixar-style animated ads. Fully generated with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance).

-
 and Instagram ads. Scroll-stopping, fast to grab attention, built to drive purchases.

- UGC-style creatives. Native, organic, believable, platform-friendly.

- Product demonstration videos. Clear, benefit-driven, product in action.

- Customer testimonial ads. Emotional and trust-building, using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof.

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos. Longer-form, educational, direct-response structure.

- Variations for testing. Different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures.



EVERY VIDEO SHOULD

- Stop people in the first 1 to 3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Keep attention with captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust with reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



We are not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals.



INPUTS AND OUTPUTS

You get: scripts, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes.

You deliver: a polished ad ready for testing.

No footage available? You generate it yourself with AI.



DAILY TASKS

- Create avatars and animate them in HeyGen

- Produce voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

- Build Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

- Research and source clips for VSLs

- Edit new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Edit with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

- Create variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improve hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapt creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Upload finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

- Collaborate with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Use feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



REQUIRED

- HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

- ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

- Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

- At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use



GOOD TO HAVE

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

- Bonus: experience in the health supplement niche



YOU'LL FIT IF YOU

- Have edited video ads for e-commerce brands

- Have produced creatives with AI tools hands-on, not just experimented

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Follow references without copying them blindly

- Have good instincts for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage compelling and conversion-focused

- Take feedback well and iterate fast

- Care whether your videos perform, not just whether they look good



One note on quality: creative that sells does not mean ugly or low quality. It means every editing choice supports the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- Work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time



We're building a serious e-commerce brand. If this describes you, apply.

title: META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR
description:
META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR

We're looking for an AI video generator/editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:



AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to make videos that:



Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds

Make the problem feel real and urgent

Show the product clearly and persuasively

Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase

You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes… then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:



Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

Can create multiple ad variations quickly

Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good

We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:



HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use

You also have experience with:



Meta/Facebook ad creatives

Short-form paid social videos

Long-form VSLs or sales videos

Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Competitive compensation based on experience

Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives

The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

Clear creative direction and fast feedback

Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.



If you're an AI video generator/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: U.S. Stock Options Day Trader / Scalper
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a motivated and disciplined U.S. Stock Options Day Trader / Scalper to join our growing trading operation.



This opportunity is designed for individuals who are serious about developing a professional trading career and understand the importance of technical analysis, options valuation, market structure, disciplined execution, and capital protection.



We are building a performance-driven trading team and looking for individuals who can identify high-quality market opportunities, make informed trading decisions, and continuously improve their skills.



This position begins with a two-hour daily trading schedule, with opportunities to advance into longer trading sessions and greater responsibilities based on demonstrated performance.



WORK SCHEDULE & ADVANCEMENT OPPORTUNITIES



Initial Schedule



* Monday–Friday

* 9:30 AM–11:30 AM Eastern Time

* 2 hours per day

* 10 hours per week

* Starting compensation: $50 USD per week



The initial assignment focuses on the opening two hours of the U.S. stock market, when traders will monitor price action, evaluate opportunities, and demonstrate their ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving trading environment.



Opportunities for Expanded Trading Hours



Successful traders may become eligible for expanded schedules, including 3-hour, 4-hour, or longer daily trading assignments.



Advanced traders may eventually qualify for assignments extending through the regular U.S. stock market session, which closes at 4:00 PM Eastern Time.



Expanded responsibilities may include monitoring additional stocks and exchange-traded funds, identifying trading opportunities throughout the day, and managing trading activity during afternoon and power-hour sessions.



Advancement is earned through demonstrated trading skill, consistency, risk management, reliability, and professional performance.



REQUIRED TRADING SKILLS & TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE



Multi-Timeframe Intraday Chart Analysis



Candidates must be capable of reading, analyzing, and interpreting price action across multiple chart timeframes, including:



* 1-minute and 2-minute charts

* 5-minute and 10-minute charts

* 15-minute and 30-minute charts

* 1-hour charts



Traders must understand how to use shorter timeframes for entry and exit decisions while analyzing higher timeframes for market structure, trend direction, and important price levels.



Candidates should be capable of monitoring multiple charts simultaneously and recognizing developing market opportunities in real time.



Candlestick Patterns & Market Structure



Candidates must understand:



* Candlestick bodies, upper and lower wicks, and closing strength

* Bullish and bearish price action

* Higher Highs, Higher Lows, Lower Highs, and Lower Lows

* Support and resistance

* Swing highs and swing lows

* Breakouts and breakdowns

* Retests and failed breakouts

* Fake-outs and price rejection

* Consolidation and choppy market conditions

* Momentum expansion and contraction

* Trend continuation and potential reversals



Traders must be capable of identifying, drawing, and interpreting important chart levels while recognizing changes in buying and selling pressure.



Opening Range Breakout & Key Market Levels



Candidates must understand and effectively utilize:



* ORB — Opening Range Breakout

* 15-minute Opening Range Breakout

* 30-minute Opening Range Breakout

* PDH — Previous Day High

* PDL — Previous Day Low

* PMH — Premarket High

* PML — Premarket Low



The trader must understand how price behaves around significant levels, including breakouts, rejection, acceptance, retests, and failed continuation attempts.



Technical Indicators & Moving Averages



Candidates should have working experience with the following indicators:



* VWAP — Volume-Weighted Average Price

* RSI — Relative Strength Index

* MACD — Moving Average Convergence Divergence

* SMA — Simple Moving Average

* EMA — Exponential Moving Average

* Price oscillators and momentum indicators



Our trading environment utilizes multiple moving-average periods, including 3, 7, 200, and 400, to evaluate short-term momentum and broader market structure.



Candidates must understand how to cross-check technical indicators with actual price action rather than relying on a single indicator for trade decisions.



OPTIONS TRADING KNOWLEDGE



Candidates must understand the fundamental mechanics of U.S. stock options, including:



* Call and put contracts

* Buy to Open and Sell to Close

* Strike prices and expiration dates

* Options premiums and contract multipliers

* In-the-Money, At-the-Money, and Out-of-the-Money contracts

* Intrinsic and extrinsic value

* Delta, Gamma, and Theta

* Implied volatility

* Volume and open interest

* Bid/ask spreads and liquidity

* Zero Days to Expiration (0DTE) options



The trader must understand how option premiums respond to underlying price movement, time decay, volatility, and proximity to the strike price.



Contract Selection & Premium Opportunities



Our trading strategy emphasizes evaluating Out-of-the-Money (OTM) calls and puts with favorable premium behavior and potential for short-term appreciation.



Candidates must understand how to compare available contracts, evaluate expected price movement, and identify situations in which an OTM option may increase in premium before reaching its strike price.



Successful traders must balance opportunity recognition with appropriate position sizing, disciplined execution, and capital protection.



PROFESSIONAL SCALPING & MARKET EXECUTION



Candidates must demonstrate an understanding of different intraday market conditions and how trading execution should adapt accordingly.



Choppy Markets: Identify established ranges, support and resistance, and suitable short-duration scalping opportunities. Recognize when quick entry and exit decisions are appropriate.



Momentum Expansion: Recognize strong bullish or bearish price movement, rapidly developing breakouts, and opportunities where an established trend may continue.



Fake-Outs & Reversals: Identify failed breakouts, weakening momentum, rejection patterns, and changes in market structure.



Low-Quality Market Conditions: Demonstrate the discipline to remain patient when trading opportunities do not meet the required criteria.



Traders must be capable of identifying potential opportunities for both calls and puts and communicating important market developments promptly.



Trade Execution & Capital Protection



Candidates must understand:



* Identifying favorable entries and exits

* Contract selection and position sizing

* Calculating potential exposure

* Trailing-stop protection

* Managing profitable positions

* Recognizing failed setups

* Controlling unnecessary losses

* Avoiding emotional or impulsive execution

* Maintaining accurate trading records



Our trading philosophy emphasizes protecting capital, recognizing opportunities early, and managing profitable trades effectively.



TRAINING & TRADING EVALUATION



Selected candidates will participate in a structured screening and evaluation process.



Trading Knowledge Assessment



Candidates will demonstrate their understanding of options trading, technical analysis, chart interpretation, and risk management.



Company Trading-System Training



Selected applicants will become familiar with our indicators, chart layouts, market-analysis procedures, communication standards, and trading methodology.



Five-Day Simulated Trading Evaluation



Candidates will complete a practical trading evaluation using a simulated account with a maximum working capital allocation of $300.



The evaluation will assess trade selection, technical analysis, entry and exit timing, capital protection, communication, trading discipline, and overall decision-making.



No personal trading funds are required.



Candidates who successfully complete the assessment may be considered for additional trading responsibilities.



COMPENSATION & LONG-TERM CAREER GROWTH



Starting Compensation: $50 USD per week



Starting Schedule: 10 hours per week



This position offers opportunities for advancement based on verified trading performance, reliability, professional development, and business needs.



Successful team members may become eligible for:



* Increased weekly compensation

* Expanded daily trading hours

* Additional market-monitoring responsibilities

* Larger approved trading capital allocations

* Advanced trading assignments

* Senior Trader and Lead Trader opportunities

* Training and mentoring future trading team members

* Long-term growth within the organization



Our goal is to develop a capable, professional trading team whose members can grow alongside the business.



We value individuals who are ambitious, disciplined, dependable, coachable, and committed to continuous improvement.



This is an opportunity to build a long-term trading career, with greater responsibilities and earning potential available to traders who consistently demonstrate the required skills and performance.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply directly through OnlineJobs.ph.



Include your résumé, a short introduction, and any relevant experience in U.S. stock options trading, day trading, or scalping.



We will review applications and contact selected candidates regarding interviews and next steps.

title: Virtual Assistant – Business Development Associate – Real Estate—Immediate Start —Multiple Vacancies Available
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT ASSOCIATE - REFERRAL PARTNERSHIPS

Remote | Full-Time | Immediate Start



TYPE OF WORK

Full-time (UK business hours)



WAGE / SALARY

$300 per month fixed + $50-$100 for every referral that becomes a paying client (unlimited potential)



HOURS PER WEEK

40 hours, mostly UK business hours (approximately 9am-5pm UK, or 4pm-midnight Philippine time)



ABOUT US

We're a growing independent UK estate agency doing sales, lettings, property management and property maintenance. We're part of a global luxury real estate network and its exclusive lettings provider in the UK.



We have the brand and the back office. What we need now is a network of local partners who send us clients.



THE ROLE

Your job is to build and run our local referral partner network, reporting directly to the boss.



You will find tradespeople and local businesses, sign them up to a formal partnership where we pay them for sending us sales, lettings, management and maintenance clients, and then keep those partners active.



Tradespeople and local businesses spend their days in people's homes and talk to homeowners and landlords all the time. We want to be the first agent they think of.



WHO YOU WILL CONTACT

Builders, plumbers, electricians, roofers, decorators, locksmiths, cleaners, removal firms, gardeners and many other trades, plus businesses such as salons, solicitors, mortgage brokers and surveyors.



You will find them on Google Maps and other directories.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Build lists of local businesses and trades in our target areas

- Contact them by phone, WhatsApp,
 and messaging, around 100 outreaches a day

- Explain the partnership and get them signed up

- Process the paperwork: send the partnership agreement, collect the signed copy and record everything in our CRM

- Keep a clear log of who has signed up, who is active and who has referred

- Follow up regularly with every partner: how business is going, whether they have met anyone who needs help, and how we can help them

- Send partners updates on the leads they have referred

- Identify the best partners and tell us who we should meet in person

- Come up with ideas to make the programme more attractive and more productive

- Send a weekly report: outreaches, sign-ups, active partners, referrals, results and what you would change



YOU MUST HAVE



- Clear, natural spoken English with a neutral accent, comfortable calling UK tradespeople

- Sales, business development, customer service or real estate experience

- Persistence in following up without being pushy

- Self-discipline to hit daily targets with little supervision

- Good written English and attention to detail with paperwork and records

- Reliable internet, a laptop or PC, and a quiet workspace

- Willingness to work UK business hours



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with a CRM

- Experience building referral or partner networks

- Property or construction industry experience

- Startup or small-team experience



PAY STRUCTURE

All payments are in USD, paid monthly by bank transfer.



FIXED BASE SALARY

$300 per month



HOW REFERRAL PAYMENTS WORK



- Referral payments apply to referrals from partners you recruit and manage, as recorded in our CRM, for 12 months from the date of each referral

- Referral payments are made once we have been paid

- Property sales: once the sale has completed

- Lettings: once the tenancy has started and the first rent has been received

- Maintenance: once the job has been completed and paid for

- No cap on referral earnings, so UNLIMITED EARNING POTENTIAL for high performers!





HOW TO APPLY

IMPORTANT: Please
 your CV and an introduction video to 



 subject line: REFERRAL BDA



*Applications without the video will not be considered.*



WHAT TO COVER IN YOUR VIDEO



Please answer the following questions:



1. What is your experience in sales, business development or real estate?

2. How would you persuade a busy plumber or builder to sign up to a referral partnership with an agency they have never heard of?

3. How would you keep hundreds of partners engaged so they actually send referrals?

4. How do you keep up consistent daily outreach, and how would you track what is working?

5. What other ideas do you have for finding people who can send us property owners?

6. How soon can you start, and can you work UK business hours?

7. Please confirm you understand the pay: a fixed base plus a fixed payment for each referral that becomes a paying client, paid after we have been paid.



We look forward to working with you!

title: Project Coordinator (Remote) – Full-Time

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys coordinating people, tracking deadlines, following up on pending tasks, and making sure important details are not overlooked. You will play an important role in improving communication, preventing delays, and helping the team stay aligned on project requirements and next steps.

If you are an excellent communicator who takes ownership of follow-ups and enjoys bringing structure to busy projects, we would love to hear from you!



Key Responsibilities

Track outstanding requests, responses, and deliverables.

Keep relevant team members informed about updates or delays.

5. Process Improvement & Administrative Support

Identify recurring issues that cause delays, misunderstandings, or errors.

Qualifications

What Success Looks Like

Your updated resume.

Portfolio

title: Fundraising & Donor Relations Coordinator
description:
Your Mission

Grow and deepen the relationships that fund Rebels for Peace by finding new supporters, stewarding existing donors, strengthening fundraising communication, and helping turn one-time donors into long-term champions of the organization.

This role exists to help Rebels for Peace become consistently excellent at donor relationships, fundraising follow-up, grant management, and communicating the impact of our work.



About Rebels for Peace

Rebels for Peace is a Chicago-based nonprofit working with youth and communities impacted by gun violence.

Through social-emotional learning, leadership development, mentorship, and community engagement, we help young people build the skills, resilience, and relationships they need to choose peace and become leaders in their communities.

We are looking for a highly organized, relationship-oriented, and proactive Fundraising & Donor Relations Coordinator who can help us strengthen the way we find, engage, and retain the people and organizations that make our work possible.

This is a hands-on development role for someone who enjoys building relationships, writing, researching opportunities, creating strong communication, and making sure important follow-up happens.



What You’ll Do

Donor Relations & Stewardship

Build and maintain strong relationships with donors, supporters, sponsors, and prospective donors.

Make sure donors are consistently thanked, updated, engaged, and shown the impact of their support throughout the year.

Track donor relationships, communication, giving history, next steps, and opportunities in the CRM.

Help the Executive Director stay prepared for donor and funder meetings with relevant background, relationship history, and recommended next steps.



Donor Growth & Fundraising

Research and identify new individual donors, corporate supporters, foundations, sponsors, and other fundraising opportunities.

Help grow and manage the fundraising pipeline from initial prospect through cultivation and ongoing stewardship.

Support outreach, follow-up, sponsorship conversations, fundraising campaigns, and donor engagement.

Help turn one-time supporters into long-term relationships with Rebels for Peace.

Rebel Games Peer to peer campaign 

Help develop a strong year-round donor communication and stewardship strategy around Rebel Games, our peer-to-peer fundraising campaign.

Support participants, donors, teams, and sponsors before, during, and after the campaign.

Help ensure Rebel Games relationships continue beyond the campaign itself and become part of the broader Rebels for Peace community.



Grants Management

Research and identify relevant foundation, corporate, and government grant opportunities.

Maintain an organized grant pipeline and track upcoming opportunities, deadlines, applications, reports, and renewals.

Draft and coordinate grant applications, letters of inquiry, proposals, and funder communications.

Coordinate with program and finance staff to gather information needed for applications and reports.

Help ensure grant reports are accurate, compelling, and submitted on time.



Fundraising Communications

Help create consistent, high-quality communication with donors and supporters.

Draft donor updates, thank-you messages, campaign communication, proposals, sponsorship materials, newsletters, and follow-up.

Gather stories, program results, photos, and impact information that help donors understand the difference their support makes.

Help make sure Rebels for Peace communicates with supporters throughout the year—not only when we are asking for money.



What Success Looks Like

In this role:

Every significant donor and prospect has a clear next step.

Existing donors are consistently stewarded throughout the year.

The donor and prospect pipeline continues to grow.

New grant opportunities are proactively identified and pursued.

Grant applications and reports are organized, strong, and submitted on time.

Rebel Games becomes a year-round relationship-building opportunity.

Donor and funder information in the CRM is accurate and actively used.

The Executive Director is well prepared for important donor and funder conversations.

Fundraising communication is consistent, thoughtful, and high quality.

More supporters move from one-time engagement to long-term relationships with Rebels for Peace.



What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

Relationship-oriented and genuinely enjoys connecting with people.

Strong at writing, communication, and follow-through.

Organized and able to manage multiple donor, grant, and fundraising priorities at once.

Proactive and comfortable identifying opportunities rather than waiting for them to appear.

Comfortable researching donors, funders, businesses, foundations, and fundraising opportunities.

Able to communicate professionally with donors, funders, executives, corporate partners, and community stakeholders.

Comfortable using CRM systems, spreadsheets,
 platforms, and other digital tools.

Detail-oriented and able to manage deadlines and important information accurately.

Interested in youth development, violence prevention, social impact, philanthropy, or community-based work.



Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following is strongly preferred:

Donor relations or donor stewardship

Fundraising

Grant research or grant writing

Development or nonprofit advancement

Sponsorships or corporate partnerships

CRM management

Fundraising campaigns or peer-to-peer fundraising

Donor or nonprofit communications

We are open to someone who is still growing in their development career but has demonstrated strong judgment, initiative, communication skills, and the ability to build relationships.



The Ideal Candidate

You are someone who sees fundraising as more than asking for money.

You believe strong fundraising starts with strong relationships. You enjoy learning about people, staying connected, communicating impact, finding new opportunities, and making sure supporters feel like they are genuinely part of the mission.

You are organized enough to manage a grant pipeline and donor CRM, but relational enough to understand that behind every entry in that system is a person who chose to believe in the work.

You help make sure Rebels for Peace does not simply find more donors—we become better at taking care of the people who already believe in us.

title: META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR
description:
META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR

We're looking for an AI video generator/editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:



AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to make videos that:



Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds

Make the problem feel real and urgent

Show the product clearly and persuasively

Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase

You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes… then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:



Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

Can create multiple ad variations quickly

Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good

We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:



HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use

You also have experience with:



Meta/Facebook ad creatives

Short-form paid social videos

Long-form VSLs or sales videos

Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Competitive compensation based on experience

Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives

The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

Clear creative direction and fast feedback

Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.



If you're an AI video generator/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.
